**MEET MIKE:** | A CHAMPION FOR PRINCIPLED LEADERSHIP

Mike learned his love for the Constitution around the family dinner table. Mike’s father, Rex Lee, served as Solicitor General under President Ronald Reagan and later as President of Brigham Young University. As a child, Mike attended his father’s arguments before the U.S. Supreme Court, giving him a unique understanding of the government from an early age. As an attorney he developed a more complete understanding of why the Constitution is essential to the protection of life, liberty, and property.

After graduating from law school in 1997, he served as a law clerk to Judge Dee Benson of the U.S. District Court for the District of Utah. He then clerked for Judge Samuel A. Alito, Jr., who was serving at that time on the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Third Circuit Court in Newark, New Jersey. After his second clerkship, he joined the Washington, D.C. office of Sidley & Austin, where he specialized in appellate and Supreme Court litigation. Several years later, Mike was invited to serve as an Assistant U.S. Attorney in Salt Lake City, preparing briefs and arguing cases before the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Tenth Circuit. He served as Governor Huntsman’s General Counsel and then went to Washington for a one-year clerkship with Justice Alito at the U.S. Supreme Court.

Following his clerkship, Mike joined the Salt Lake office of the Washington, D.C.-based law firm of Howrey LLP. Mike has earned a reputation as an outstanding lawyer based on his sound judgment, writing and courtroom advocacy skills, and thorough understanding of the Constitution. Mike and Sharon have three children and live in Provo, Utah.

#### Announcement
**>From the Desk of Haneefah Khaaliq** Dear Hoosiers, a few months ago, I told you I was preparing a very special message for you that would be released soon in the form of an exclusive interview and short documentary. The [exclusive interview](https://haneefahkhaaliq.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b985b4d189b8b7b204cdd6958&id=fc23b17e65&e=a49cb82bb3) was already released. I'm now happy to share with you the [short documentary](https://haneefahkhaaliq.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b985b4d189b8b7b204cdd6958&id=c83d26aa2b&e=a49cb82bb3).

After being swiftly removed from the primaries by the Indiana Election Commission, I suspected foul play and conducted a five-month investigation. As a result of unconscionable findings, I petitioned the Indiana Supreme Court and announced my decision to continue in this year's senate race as a write-in candidate.

It's important for you to understand that I would've had no problem bowing out of this election cycle, but not under these conditions. In this [documentary](https://haneefahkhaaliq.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b985b4d189b8b7b204cdd6958&id=b221840b57&e=a49cb82bb3), I reveal to you the findings of my investigation and also my next political moves. If the cost of seeking justice means losing support then that's a price I'm willing to pay.
**Now, here's what I need you to do right now: **
* Share this message with nine (9) of your friends and family. Choose three (3) of them to personally call and inform!
* Commit to my campaign now by [donating $9](https://haneefahkhaaliq.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b985b4d189b8b7b204cdd6958&id=e671f08abc&e=a49cb82bb3) or more to keep this true grassroots campaign going.
* [Subscribe and follow me on social media](https://haneefahkhaaliq.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b985b4d189b8b7b204cdd6958&id=17c74ce846&e=a49cb82bb3) where I'm active and live often. Share a post or two!

Visit [haneefahkhaaliq.org](https://haneefahkhaaliq.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b985b4d189b8b7b204cdd6958&id=ae46a63ebf&e=a49cb82bb3), view my 33 national policies and agendas, and become a volunteer today! I am Indiana. You are Indiana. Together, we are Indiana!

Sincerely,
Haneefah Khaaliq, Esq.

| | | Peter,

I have never seen the Left more aggressive and out of control as they are in the last few days and weeks. Long gone are the days of polite discourse, the days when we could have disagreements without it ending in riots and chaos. Not only is the left posting the personal addresses of SCOTUS members on Twitter, but in Washington DC, activists are giving cash to restaurants to "out" SCOTUS members if they dine in.

I knew when I announced my campaign for re-election that this would be a campaign unlike one I've ever seen before, and it has. The vitriol and slander I've seen so far this year has never been paralleled.

The days of decorum have disappeared, but can and need to return. And that's why I'm running for re-election. Democrats have let major cities become crime ridden, they are behind the rising inflation we are experiencing at the pump and grocery stores, and this is just the beginning of their mayhem.

This is not a landscape that I want our children and grandchildren growing up in. I will always fight for their future, and I hope if you stand with me in that fight you'll stand with me right now in this campaign.

I hate asking for money - it's my least favorite thing to do. But the facts are simple. Democrats across the country are gearing up to make this Wisconsin Senate race the most expensive in history in an attempt to not just defeat me, but defeat our values and beliefs.

No donation is too small. $5 makes a difference. $5 can help us reach that one undecided voter and ensure they get out and vote and keep WI red.

I know our nation's brightest days are ahead of us, but getting there isn't going to be easy. _**[We can win in November if I can count on your support right now.](http://links.bestamericanow.com/u/click?_t=f6e78b69acbb4291bd75bc93fae35a62&_m=5c72c3e1a8e6402898a3ed135f9621fe&_e=xfWejir0GsiK_ZnSGgE3gkgQNa4-THX_LwAgip-_mwW_2CUQBPPYM2sz9hLEnSQeMI-0Zg9fRfbnctg2PK6qaxa6gnDAz7TcdByhqOHdwzNU0-DLZOhVegGQBwrkGLKRgK81WV6EdzxZNTjr2_Rms-Ztz1MmzlVDFiBeufeHyDmDnx3mmbhAMPIm5Xb8mHpxrSCIl0baJxLScAGx_NoZ13gISwmBrvMJNEHwEa_MBdup43xm2K98pdRMxyc2-gIiehD3O8c23e6XV83IFoqiyvYBDWuw5SF_oM6rS7hpro7lHIdmKIu8LQ3suCLdSGAD6kKlonPvrrRIYB6WCghmIYnDS2kgKGi7uMxY9sCOHJl6LR67ByaeSE2jxu_R5T1m "Johnson1")**_

Peter,

_We have a very special favor to ask of you._

During a recent meeting, we shared fond memories of President Trump’s time in office and how much he was able to accomplish with the support of Grassroot Conservatives like YOU.

Some of the stories were so moving that we decided to write a letter for President Trump to thank him for everything he’s done, and we were hoping that you could co-sign it with us.

[**Please add your name below to thank President Trump for working so hard on behalf of the American People. >>**](http://links.freedomtrainalert.com/u/click?_t=2d4f229f156142619b4e4f956d2d65c9&_m=e684a7e60302446f8b6298359fa8c10e&_e=UbvyHphG_81gMIDxm8_2g4ZdzqyD08W2at8mkrx0aTcgI-eRZ2WnYnN5ja75C7dXiv93Gl-lR2ephhsPdos-eseoDSm5f-pH-6rggUUN7VYK9i7HiZW-85jrvnfzW4pETrZW-0XVaM7jJbd4fIu_v9fLUu9CTes4pVTxUqeX-49Rq_Y8UyrgyE_zzsM3qTaflopUlca6QNYsfjyM5SiR0wlgUZL2kGCzDmPuHE-IfUYhRVrGWof6doVtmmLq0-5x1of-Y1hVPqeRSHttUptTDB5v5wSS0bvC6RgNto0bvG2upA6w-HVADHHaLx6ZvK6FGsh2Wmg5DmgbgZCqsxlisr6SYk3qVdLO2jUus8IhQLxV20TQyoVlSJXeK6ppHfeIFqTtapyvq9ttj52RAdd6SAmlH-0xMVvqqkgwijr-xxSx2rDvLbd0iCW2Y1bru81VLKabi3OIGbZQEP2Yy5_Tlg%3D%3D)

* * *
**_Dear President Trump,

You were the greatest President of all time because you put AMERICA FIRST.

Under your incredible leadership, our Southern Border was secure, our economy was strong, inflation was under control, and America was respected around the world.

The Fake News media may try to cover up all your accomplishments to make Biden look like less of a failure, but the American People know the TRUTH. We know that you fought for us, which is why we want you to know how much we appreciate everything you continue to do for us.

Thank you,

The American People_**
[**CO-SIGN NOW ⇒**](http://links.freedomtrainalert.com/u/click?_t=2d4f229f156142619b4e4f956d2d65c9&_m=e684a7e60302446f8b6298359fa8c10e&_e=UbvyHphG_81gMIDxm8_2g4ZdzqyD08W2at8mkrx0aTcgI-eRZ2WnYnN5ja75C7dXiv93Gl-lR2ephhsPdos-eseoDSm5f-pH-6rggUUN7VYK9i7HiZW-85jrvnfzW4pETrZW-0XVaM7jJbd4fIu_v9fLUu9CTes4pVTxUqeX-49Rq_Y8UyrgyE_zzsM3qTaflopUlca6QNYsfjyM5SiR0wlgUZL2kGCzDmPuHE-IfUYhRVrGWof6doVtmmLq0-5x1of-Y1hVPqeRSHttUptTDB5v5wSS0bvC6RgNto0bvG2upA6w-HVADHHaLx6ZvK6FGijCzgYfz4kyHVF_UxenSMN08wAA4yqmfhVBsMdVBbo-0Vf7mLM5PsPLiZoM_WQUuQXGGymDu6ouMCcOPcIPgnMegJ2yYQD7Ui2uuQfa5P-sVLg4xmaPWh37MY9LVf7-uwkgAQwwIVHM9FJyzL8g5A%3D%3D)

**MEET MIKE:** | A CHAMPION FOR PRINCIPLED LEADERSHIP

Mike learned his love for the Constitution around the family dinner table. Mike’s father, Rex Lee, served as Solicitor General under President Ronald Reagan and later as President of Brigham Young University. As a child, Mike attended his father’s arguments before the U.S. Supreme Court, giving him a unique understanding of the government from an early age. As an attorney he developed a more complete understanding of why the Constitution is essential to the protection of life, liberty, and property.

After graduating from law school in 1997, he served as a law clerk to Judge Dee Benson of the U.S. District Court for the District of Utah. He then clerked for Judge Samuel A. Alito, Jr., who was serving at that time on the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Third Circuit Court in Newark, New Jersey. After his second clerkship, he joined the Washington, D.C. office of Sidley & Austin, where he specialized in appellate and Supreme Court litigation. Several years later, Mike was invited to serve as an Assistant U.S. Attorney in Salt Lake City, preparing briefs and arguing cases before the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Tenth Circuit. He served as Governor Huntsman’s General Counsel and then went to Washington for a one-year clerkship with Justice Alito at the U.S. Supreme Court.

Following his clerkship, Mike joined the Salt Lake office of the Washington, D.C.-based law firm of Howrey LLP. Mike has earned a reputation as an outstanding lawyer based on his sound judgment, writing and courtroom advocacy skills, and thorough understanding of the Constitution. Mike and Sharon have three children and live in Provo, Utah.

body:
Really???
#
Hey Derek, remember when I emailed you a few weeks ago about Tucker Carlson attacking me for some BS on Fox News?
**Well, last night he did it AGAIN!!!**
[](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20220908-3?refcode=em20220908-7177&refcode2=7177_434096_tRU194&akid=7177%2E434096%2EtRU194)
**[Fight Back Now](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20220908-3?amount=5&refcode=em20220908-7177&refcode2=7177_434096_tRU194&akid=7177%2E434096%2EtRU194)**
The dude spent *17 full minutes* trying to drag me through the mud.
**But the best part was when he called me out for wearing hoodies + having “fraudulent tattoos.” 🤔**
Look, this guy is trying every attack in the book (and even some that aren’t in the book LOL) to tear me + our grassroots movement down. So Derek, I need your help to keep fighting back against all this Fox News BS.
**[Can you please rush a donation of $5 or more to my campaign today? Over the next 61 days, these attacks are only going to keep coming and we need to be prepared for every moment like this.](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20220908-3?refcode=em20220908-7177&refcode2=7177_434096_tRU194&akid=7177%2E434096%2EtRU194)**
**[Contribute Now](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20220908-3?amount=5&refcode=em20220908-7177&refcode2=7177_434096_tRU194&akid=7177%2E434096%2EtRU194)**
These are definitely some of the weirdest attacks I’ve gotten yet. **But if there’s anything I want to clear up, it’s about my *very real* tattoos.**
I know I’ve probably emailed you about it before, but I have tattoos on both of my arms. On my left arm, the ZIP code of Braddock, where I was honored to serve as mayor for 13 years + continue to raise my family. On my right arm are nine dates, which each represent a real person we lost through violence while I was mayor.
[](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20220908-3?refcode=em20220908-7177&refcode2=7177_434096_tRU194&akid=7177%2E434096%2EtRU194)
As a member of the community, those losses were personal to me. But as mayor, I always felt a sense of responsibility and obligation to those people + families since it happened under my watch. By tattooing them on my arms, all those people will stay with me forever.
I took my commitment seriously back then as mayor of Braddock and now as lieutenant governor of PA. And that’s exactly what I plan to do in the U.S. Senate next year.
Thanks for having my back, Derek.
❤️ John
John Fetterman
Lieutenant Governor of Pennsylvania
Democratic Nominee for U.S. Senate

name: Christine Drazan
subject: For your morning cup of coffee. ☕
body:
Here’s my latest op-ed in The Oregonian!
[](https://christinedrazanforgovernoror.cmail19.com/t/y-l-ngkrul-iukrjimdh-r/) _For your morning cup of coffee,_[__**here 's my latest op-ed in The Oregonian!**__](https://christinedrazanforgovernoror.cmail19.com/t/y-l-ngkrul-iukrjimdh-j/)⬇️ ⬇️ ⬇️ [](https://christinedrazanforgovernoror.cmail19.com/t/y-l-ngkrul-iukrjimdh-t/) _I am an Oregonian and my life is an Oregon story._ Originally from Klamath Falls, I was raised during a time of job losses in the natural resource industry, which affected not only our family, but our entire community. These struggles gave me the gift of compassion for anyone facing a tough time and a sense of responsibility to make things better. Even then, it was hard to miss the connection between the hardships facing too many families in our area, _and the politicians who left people behind - **too often making things worse, not better.**_ [RUSH $10 | LEAD OREGON IN A NEW DIRECTION ☀️](https://christinedrazanforgovernoror.cmail19.com/t/y-l-ngkrul-iukrjimdh-i/) It's been years and miles since those days, but once again, far too many Oregonians are being left behind. Families are less stable, streets are less safe and opportunities have been dimmed by politicians who have pushed to exercise power instead of serving Oregonians. _Put simply,**they have made things worse, not better.**__The Oregon we know and love is hurting._**_It doesn 't have to be this way._**I'm running for governor because I want to improve the lives of Oregon families across our state. [RUSH $10 | LEAD OREGON IN A NEW DIRECTION ☀️](https://christinedrazanforgovernoror.cmail19.com/t/y-l-ngkrul-iukrjimdh-d/) Earlier this month, I released my _**[Roadmap for Oregon 's Future](https://christinedrazanforgovernoror.cmail19.com/t/y-l-ngkrul-iukrjimdh-h/)**_. It's my plan to lead Oregon in a new direction by tackling homelessness, public safety, affordability, education and more. It's the product of countless conversations I've had with Oregonians from all walks of life across the state. _This roadmap represents my commitment to serve the needs of Oregonians with a clear vision for change,**starting on Day One.**_ To improve the lives of Oregonians we must start by tackling the crisis in our streets. I will declare a homelessness state of emergency, unlocking the tools necessary to ensure homelessness is rare and temporary instead of permanent and chronic. I will advocate for the repeal of Measure 110, which decriminalized hard drugs like heroin and methamphetamine and worsened _**[our addiction crisis](https://christinedrazanforgovernoror.cmail19.com/t/y-l-ngkrul-iukrjimdh-k/)**_. My first budget will expand investments in addiction and mental health supports and services so that Oregonians who need help, can get help--_ensuring we address this crisis with both compassion and accountability._ [RUSH $10 | LEAD OREGON IN A NEW DIRECTION ☀️](https://christinedrazanforgovernoror.cmail19.com/t/y-l-ngkrul-iukrjimdh-u/) My roadmap sets a path to restore community safety and the rule of law. Portland's experience with increased violence is front page news. _**[Homicides](https://christinedrazanforgovernoror.cmail19.com/t/y-l-ngkrul-iukrjimdh-o/)**_ in 2021 were up 207% from 2019. People no longer feel safe in their own neighborhoods. Politicians have destabilized law enforcement by _**[defunding the police](https://christinedrazanforgovernoror.cmail19.com/t/y-l-ngkrul-iukrjimdh-b/)**_ and allowing political agendas to weaken community safety. _**My administration will stand with law enforcement and help put more officers on the streets to restore safety in our neighborhoods.**_ Oregonians need relief as the cost of living in Oregon continues to rise. From the cost of gas to the cost of buying a home, it has never been more expensive to live and raise a family in Oregon. My two opponents linked arms with Kate Brown to make Oregon _**[one of the most expensive states](https://christinedrazanforgovernoror.cmail19.com/t/y-l-ngkrul-iukrjimdh-n/)**_ in the nation. Together, they supported a $2 billion-a-biennium hidden sales tax and more than _**[$5.3 billion](https://christinedrazanforgovernoror.cmail19.com/t/y-l-ngkrul-iukrjimdh-p/)**_ worth of new gas taxes and vehicle registration fees. Their votes have added an extra layer of inflation at a time when we can least afford it. _**I will lead by vetoing unnecessary new tax increases, putting a moratorium on new mandates and reviewing existing regulations that drive up costs within my first 100 days.**_ [RUSH $10 | LEAD OREGON IN A NEW DIRECTION ☀️](https://christinedrazanforgovernoror.cmail19.com/t/y-l-ngkrul-iukrjimdh-x/) Oregonians are rightly proud of our state. We're blessed to live in a state with unrivaled natural beauty, hardworking people and strong communities.But Oregon is not in this mess by accident. We are here because of the failed policies of Kate Brown and those in power who lowered education standards, made neighborhoods less safe and raised prices. We can't afford more of the same failed ideas that have harmed Oregon and left too many Oregonians behind. I hope you will join me in working to lead our state in a new direction. [RUSH $10 | LEAD OREGON IN A NEW DIRECTION ☀️](https://christinedrazanforgovernoror.cmail19.com/t/y-l-ngkrul-iukrjimdh-m/) ### | [Unsubscribe](https://christinedrazanforgovernoror.cmail19.com/t/y-u-ngkrul-iukrjimdh-c/)

# [Death to monarchy](https://substack.com/redirect/2/eyJlIjoiaHR0cHM6Ly9zaGFoaWRidXR0YXIuc3Vic3RhY2suY29tL3AvZGVhdGgtdG8tbW9uYXJjaHk_.6Qn6daJIgJA5EtnngBG3fXyz18R2gBvV6zlnfR87WMc?)
### There's a guy who claims the title--with a straight face, in the year of our Lord 2022--of King Charles III
[](https://substack.com/redirect/33ca8baf-96e8-445f-97bd-78e953fc86c6?r=1hvr60)| [Shahid Buttar](https://substack.com/redirect/33ca8baf-96e8-445f-97bd-78e953fc86c6?r=1hvr60)| | Sep 9
---|---
Across the world, sycophants and apologists for colonialism have spent today mourning the death of Queen Elizabeth II.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/1596b834-7f4e-495f-ab4b-fc1ddbb4fa1f?r=1hvr60)|
---|---|---
I celebrate her death, as I would the demise of any monarch.
Monarchy has been antithetical to human rights since its inception. It invited no end of horrors--from plunder and pillage to ransom and rape--for millennia before most countries finally repudiated it. Some, like the United Kingdom, preserved it while at least modifying the divine right of kings to place the whims of monarchs beneath the decisions of democratically accountable institutions.
Yet, even though the United Kingdom's "constitutional monarchy" limits the avarice and arbitrariness of monarchical rule, it remains a blight on humanity. I say this as a child of the British colonial empire, and one among the many diasporas it unleashed across the world.
[Shahid Buttar for Change @ShahidForChangeHaving been born in the UK as a result of the continuing legacy of colonialism, I celebrate the death of Queen Elizabeth--and every monarch. Monarchy has no place in the world today. It never did, and was nothing more than an excuse for theft and brutality. AJ+ @ajplusKing Charles III is now head of state in 14 countries outside the UK -- a legacy of British colonization. But some have indicated plans to cut those ties: In Jamaica, officials have said they plan to become a republic and seek $10 billion in reparations for the slave trade. https://t.co/pBcCbxjxDH](https://substack.com/redirect/478192d6-b890-41f4-be27-abb1262d3724?r=1hvr60)[September 8th 202269 Retweets430 Likes](https://substack.com/redirect/478192d6-b890-41f4-be27-abb1262d3724?r=1hvr60)
[If you use either [Facebook](https://substack.com/redirect/a9fd155f-8971-4b42-914d-7f31c4cc531c?r=1hvr60) or [Instagram](https://substack.com/redirect/1e7bb94d-864c-417b-92f1-19e57d819156?r=1hvr60), feel free to share similar posts on each of those platforms]
The British crown enjoys vast wealth accumulated over centuries. Much of it was stolen through conquest and appropriation. Reparations have never been offered, and the continuing legacy of that era of British colonialism continues to drive international conflict from South Asia to the Middle East.
Queen Elizabeth may have been a less terrifying leader than her predecessors, but that's largely because British aristocrats extracted concessions that have over time dramatically limited the power of the throne. Even if her political power paled in comparison with that of her predecessors, however, her wealth certainly did not. Her personal net worth in 2019 was over half a billion dollars, plus $25 billion in land and estates.
That has all been inherited by someone who--with a straight face, in the year of our Lord 2022--claims the title of "King Charles III."
Charles [I refuse to sincerely use a monarchical honorific for yet another generation of entitled parasites] also inherits an annual subsidy worth over $115 million in 2021. Upon the death of his mother, he became the head of state in 14 countries well beyond the United Kingdom.
Elizabeth was the longest-lived and longest-reigning monarch in British history. Only one documented monarch in world history outlived her. That is to say, she benefited from the parasitic scam of monarchy, skimming off the top of the British--and world--economies, for longer than anyone else in history.
Many gave her medals. She'll likely gain further posthumous honors.
As a child of British colonialism, here's the song I wish our dear departed Queen could hear. She, and every other monarch around the world who clings to an archaic mode of government that spits in the face of democracy and human dignity, could learn a few things from the West African musical visionary who wrote it...

name: Your America
subject: Your invitation: National Survey on Socialism
body:
A few years ago, New York magazine posed the question: “When Did Everyone Become a Socialist?” [](http://click.youramerica.news/Pages/BC.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c920805%7c6932%7c7%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz%7c0&wdmdk=xLuobFx7C61mJLT%2bzVZ%2bCA&sysid=1)
| | | This sponsored message from Your America News is on behalf of Hillsdale College [](http://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c85692%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=79aeOpCwqYsrcUivMDvLgw&sysid=1)
---
| |
Dear Fellow American, A few years ago, _New York _magazine posed the question: “When Did Everyone Become a Socialist?” This is, of course, an exaggeration. But it makes clear that the far-Left in America aims to bring about a “Great Reset” of our economy and our way of life. In a recent issue of _Imprimis_ --Hillsdale College’s digest of liberty--author Michael Rectenwald described the economic goal of the Great Reset as “‘capitalism with Chinese characteristics’--a two-tiered economy, with profitable monopolies and the state on top and socialism for the majority below.” Today, as a supporter of liberty, you can help Hillsdale College understand the extent of support for--and opposition to--socialism. Your input will help us develop the most effective strategy to fight for the future of liberty in our country. **Will you please share your views on the political, social, and cultural forces promoting socialism in our country by completing your National Survey on Socialism using the secure link below?** **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/take-the-national-survey-on-socialism/](http://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c85693%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=0rAwpCeweGOsgA4uRjfsyg&sysid=1)** Sadly, socialism is becoming increasingly popular, especially among the young. You may be aware of a SHOCKING survey showing that... **. . . during the COVID-19 pandemic, support for socialism among those 16 to 23 years old jumped to 49 percent, and socialism also increased in popularity among all ages. ** **Why is this?** Draconian government lockdown measures destroyed businesses and eliminated competitors of corporate monopolists. These policies were a dream come true for corporate socialists. At the same time, too many young Americans have not been taught what socialism really means. Or the dismal history of its failures wherever it has been tried. This is a result of the far-Left’s “long march through the institutions”--including colleges and universities, K-12 schools, and the media. Marxist-inspired critical race theory is a prime example. Once confined to the classrooms of far-Left professors, critical race theory has infiltrated every level of government, as well as school boards and even the military. But it is in our schools where the effects of critical race theory--which teaches young Americans to categorize their fellow citizens according to race--are most dangerous. You may recall that many young Americans with college degrees who championed socialist policies participated in the riots and violence we witnessed in the summer of 2020. In the face of well-financed and widespread efforts to destroy free markets and individual liberty, Hillsdale’s work to **reach** and **teach** millions has never been more urgently needed. **That’s why I need your thoughts quickly. ** By responding to the **National Survey on Socialism **in the next five days**, **your honest opinions will help us understand the recent rise of socialism and develop our strategy to **reach** and **teach** increasing millions of Americans on behalf of liberty. We hope to hear from friends representing every part of the country. Education is the surest way to turn back this dangerous trend. And your partnership with Hillsdale College is critical. As Winston Churchill said, “Socialism is the philosophy of failure, the creed of ignorance, and the gospel of envy.” If you agree, please represent your state and take the **National Survey on Socialism** today. **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/take-the-national-survey-on-socialism/](http://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c85693%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=0rAwpCeweGOsgA4uRjfsyg&sysid=1)** Despite the recent successes of the far-Left, we must remember--**it is NEVER too late to defend liberty through education**. Warm regards, Larry P. Arnn President, Hillsdale College Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844
---
_625 First Street #183, Alexandria, VA 22314_
_[Unsubscribe](http://click.youramerica.news/Pages/OptOut.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c920805%7c6932%7c7%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz%7c0&wdmdk=xLuobFx7C61mJLT%2bzVZ%2bCA&sysid=1)_

**What Alan Greenspan Told Me About The Dollar Should Worry Everyone**
| | | Hi there, it's Dr. Ron Paul.

Alan Greenspan once told me the Federal Reserve **_"has learned to treat the dollar like gold."_**

As much as that may be the case, there is a huge difference!

While the amount of gold is finite, Dollars can be virtually printed WITHOUT restraint.
---
|
---
| |
Because of this, the dollar is rapidly losing value.

For example, this March, we reached a four-decade high of 8.5% inflation. And many economists predict this trend will continue.If it does, **your retirement account could soon be a fraction of its former value!**

So what can you do?

There are two solutions:

1. You could simply buy gold or silver and keep it in a home safe or safety deposit box.

2. Use a gold-backed IRA account.

The problem with #1 is your purchase will use after-tax income. But a Gold IRA is done with before-tax income, saving you thousands of dollars in taxes.

So depending on your unique situation, the second option may be your best choice.
Why? Because a Gold IRA allows you to take advantage of the security of precious metals inside of a tax-advantaged account.

**You can even transfer**** _your current retirement funds_****into a new Gold IRA without fees or penalties.**

When it comes to _WHERE_ to go to get your Gold IRA, I strongly encourage you to speak to Birch Gold Group. I trust them enough to mention them during TV interviews (you may have heard me mention them on Fox News recently).

Birch Gold has published a [**_FREE info kit on Gold IRAs which you can get by clicking here_**](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2z63fvpr0mk95jgunmsqjshgcgpeirv04e4do3ptg_rp22sh2s8i66or2cth68oj2cdh2bs).

Inside this no-obligation guide, you will see all the benefits of opening a Gold IRA account.

1020 US-70 West, Hillsborough

> ICYMI
> Vikram Wins WMUR Debate
---
In-Case-You-Missed-It: Vikram was the clear winner of last night's Republican primary debate on WMUR. He provided clear and concise answers to the questions that were on the minds of many Granite State families. He spent the hour making the case on why he is the candidate that will defeat Maggie Hassan in November.
Vikram used his closing statement to leave the voters with a simple message: we need an outsider in DC to fix the problems our nation is facing.
Vikram said, "Thank you Adam and everyone who tuned in this evening."
"Let me tell you how I see this election. As he's told you, Kevin has been running for office since he was 19 years old. And Chuck's been running since I was 19 years old. I haven't spent the last 30 years running for office. I've spent the last 30 years running businesses. I'm the son of immigrants who went from pumping gas at my dad's station to advising Fortune 500 companies."
"It's time to stop the career politicians from bankrupting our country and brainwashing our kids."
"Enough is enough. Send me, an outsider with fresh ideas, to Washington to fix this mess. We need to restore the promise of America - the promise of equal opportunity, not equal outcomes. The promise that hard work matters. And the promise of a better future."
"And my last message is for Maggie Hassan. Maggie, you and the career politicians have broken this country. It's time for a businessman to fix it."
"Thank you very much and I ask for your vote next Tuesday. Don't send another politician to DC, send a businessman."

You can watch the full debate [HERE](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001GskxmxZ_Pu_1c9xVDmu_8iwHVRQQ-xCC6f_mvOABLcG8cD5aTAU093GjUmOQekcdHGy_xw94VQdKtsTKPunH2q-A1rPxZ0vGH93DifIRCo02NHeSoSRnb6557jjsnwUpbE0SUz1jRlm3xVp_p_g1o-26YAvpUwA0hKRmNN4Uk98LBqwpk70niXnQC6TndBOJ-PEN-wiiWWzcCY5ZnL9XFBCdPe6mJIkeQ2o9DEND01Q=&c=FL_WJE7eDhMpdTRtmsKfxtMK8HBbAym5e48Vm1zJDwdzzZVtotdrtw==&ch=NwPagXabVSzmyLPDxU2m7engJwgHAjw_7Pvt4ld8t80EqZUmx6_VTg==).

name: American Defense News
subject: Survey on an urgent matter
body:
A movement is growing, led by progressives—but supported by many well-meaning Americans—to change the way we elect our presi
[View this message in your browser](https://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2z9fe9565fn50r38m6fa3nd3qa0ellcg9dhekf2po_rp22sh2s8i66or2cth62o77c1h238h5e8he485he5o7csn7kuij791lmkp79dhk6eojacpl6er7actl6tr779hnmmrq8cjm62qb6t9nkjhf4onkshgn8d9iespr9ojl64o71d3kelhm2c71e5r76t3169pjddb768r63c70cdhj0puie1p68dhgm9j74t1hepge1d3563gbacb4spj6cc9gmdijfclkcor65ddgcuobapbi4no)
This sponsored message from American Defense News is on behalf of Hillsdale College [](https://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2z9laq8rb2e6i2f0rd2oc43nrv9126579es2qkong_rp22sh2s8i66or2cth62o77c1h2bs) Dear Fellow American, I am enclosing a survey on a very urgent matter. It will only take a moment of your time, but the topic is vital to our nation’s future. A movement is growing, led by progressives—but supported by many well-meaning Americans—to change the way we elect our president. In effect, it seeks to do away with the Electoral College as devised by the Framers of our Constitution. That’s why Hillsdale College is conducting a **National Survey on Presidential Selection.** By completing this survey and returning it to me as soon as possible, you will help Hillsdale College more clearly understand the views of mainstream Americans concerning this issue—views we will make available to policymakers and opinion leaders. You can complete the **National Survey on Presidential Selection** by using the link below: **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/electoral-college-survey](https://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2z2nqlm1tbd8io10luf2q0jg3a10bbdt6scbig4hg_rp22sh2s8i66or2cth62o77c1h2bs)** For most of our nation’s history, the Electoral College, as devised by the Framers of our Constitution, was not controversial. Indeed, it was considered essential to preserving free and representative government. **But today, more than a dozen states have joined together in an attempt to undermine this constitutional bulwark of liberty.** This movement to undermine the Constitution has grown largely because of the failure of America’s schools to provide young people with a proper grounding in American civics—too many Americans simply don’t understand the importance of the Constitution, including the Electoral College, to liberty. Because of this, Hillsdale College has expanded its educational mission on behalf of liberty nationwide, directly teaching **millions** of Americans in all 50 states. These efforts, which aim to counter the Left’s domination over most of our schools, include:
* **Teaching** millions of citizens nationwide through free online courses, such as “Constitution 101” and “The Great American Story: A Land of Hope;”
* **Reaching** over 5.6 million households and businesses nationwide with _Imprimis_ , Hillsdale’s free digest of liberty;
* **Promoting** constitutional education through social media outlets popular with young people;
* **Sending** millions of pocket-size copies of America’s founding documents to citizens and K-12 schools across America, as well as to members of our armed forces; and
* **Restoring** excellence to K-12 education through Hillsdale’s Barney Charter School Initiative, which launches and provides guidance to classical K-12 charter schools nationwide.

Your answers to the **National Survey on Presidential Selection** will help Hillsdale form the most effective strategy to educate millions of Americans about the importance of the Constitution to liberty—including the importance of the Electoral College. **And this is especially important in this critical time for America’s future.** So please share your views on this urgent topic by completing our **National Survey on Presidential Selection** and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a few minutes of your time. **You can take the survey using this secure link I've provided below:** **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/electoral-college-survey](https://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zv0gs38erfd939ptf42tccd9imqtg7acemo9goko_rp22sh2s8i66or2cth62o77c1h2bs)** And after you take your survey, I hope you will also consider supporting Hillsdale College with a tax-deductible gift. Since 1844, Hillsdale has been “pursuing truth and defending liberty.” Today, it does so through its extensive educational outreach efforts, while refusing to accept ONE PENNY of government funding—not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans. The support of private citizens like you is essential to our work. Please represent your state and take the **National Survey on Presidential Selection today**. Thank you for your time and attention—and for your friendship and support of liberty. Warm regards, Larry P. Arnn President, Hillsdale College Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844

subject: Survey on an urgent matter
body:
A movement is growing, led by progressives—but supported by many well-meaning Americans—to change the way we elect our presi
[View this message in your browser](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2zgr2pm3nfsg161mr0k1gl4jsvqdqgv359uc9hvh0_rp2ash2s8gb2sbgebjqf99jkgqracjkmoq37chieiqj6d5jmspqcdtlmui34thgmipnadt4sbp65tdjcpoebcrme8om6d76cep62sjkm5g6acb5ekq60odgedq37d33m9gr9ppjcjg6fkjge9i3cc5icpp78cbmc3gb8p9gs2qj2p76cpj32c5jckrr5d366phbbcr7m2qmash1k8gn48n24hhm6oj7c9gm1pr3c8iv0)
This sponsored message from American Briefing is on behalf of Hillsdale College [](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2zni6qfvler5pg9fjstnk2636l10cmf8dddejfhh0_rp22sh2s8i66or2cth62o77cdh2bs) Dear Fellow American, I am enclosing a survey on a very urgent matter. It will only take a moment of your time, but the topic is vital to our nation’s future. A movement is growing, led by progressives—but supported by many well-meaning Americans—to change the way we elect our president. In effect, it seeks to do away with the Electoral College as devised by the Framers of our Constitution. That’s why Hillsdale College is conducting a **National Survey on Presidential Selection.** By completing this survey and returning it to me as soon as possible, you will help Hillsdale College more clearly understand the views of mainstream Americans concerning this issue—views we will make available to policymakers and opinion leaders. You can complete the **National Survey on Presidential Selection** by using the link below: **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/electoral-college-survey](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2zncv5b5ja1hqa5eo9tb2ca2ful458701ie3thof8_rp22sh2s8i66or2cth62o77cdh2bs)** For most of our nation’s history, the Electoral College, as devised by the Framers of our Constitution, was not controversial. Indeed, it was considered essential to preserving free and representative government. **But today, more than a dozen states have joined together in an attempt to undermine this constitutional bulwark of liberty.** This movement to undermine the Constitution has grown largely because of the failure of America’s schools to provide young people with a proper grounding in American civics—too many Americans simply don’t understand the importance of the Constitution, including the Electoral College, to liberty. Because of this, Hillsdale College has expanded its educational mission on behalf of liberty nationwide, directly teaching **millions** of Americans in all 50 states. These efforts, which aim to counter the Left’s domination over most of our schools, include:
* **Teaching** millions of citizens nationwide through free online courses, such as “Constitution 101” and “The Great American Story: A Land of Hope;”
* **Reaching** over 5.6 million households and businesses nationwide with _Imprimis_ , Hillsdale’s free digest of liberty;
* **Promoting** constitutional education through social media outlets popular with young people;
* **Sending** millions of pocket-size copies of America’s founding documents to citizens and K-12 schools across America, as well as to members of our armed forces; and
* **Restoring** excellence to K-12 education through Hillsdale’s Barney Charter School Initiative, which launches and provides guidance to classical K-12 charter schools nationwide.

Your answers to the **National Survey on Presidential Selection** will help Hillsdale form the most effective strategy to educate millions of Americans about the importance of the Constitution to liberty—including the importance of the Electoral College. **And this is especially important in this critical time for America’s future.** So please share your views on this urgent topic by completing our **National Survey on Presidential Selection** and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a few minutes of your time. **You can take the survey using this secure link I've provided below:** **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/electoral-college-survey](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2z7f35t1q9rgnbu79du5ulevd3u1h7n4jeo6nb3c0_rp22sh2s8i66or2cth62o77cdh2bs)** And after you take your survey, I hope you will also consider supporting Hillsdale College with a tax-deductible gift. Since 1844, Hillsdale has been “pursuing truth and defending liberty.” Today, it does so through its extensive educational outreach efforts, while refusing to accept ONE PENNY of government funding—not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans. The support of private citizens like you is essential to our work. Please represent your state and take the **National Survey on Presidential Selection today**. Thank you for your time and attention—and for your friendship and support of liberty. Warm regards, Larry P. Arnn President, Hillsdale College Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844

name: Raphael Warnock
subject: one thing you should probably know about me
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Rosen for Nevada
body:
I want to quickly explain exactly what we're fighting for
| | |
---
Friend, I know that in a neck-and-neck race like this one, it's easy to focus solely on things like the latest polling numbers or the day's fundraising goal. **So I want to quickly explain exactly what we're fighting for – and _why_ winning here in Georgia matters so much.**
Our movement is about building a better, brighter future for _all_. It's about ensuring that everyone has an equal voice in our government – and a fair shot at the American dream.
That means defending and expanding our constitutional right to vote. It means protecting reproductive freedom nationwide. It means making health care more affordable, bringing economic justice to our communities, and lowering the everyday costs that make it difficult for too many families to make ends meet.
**Friend, our movement is about _you_ – your priorities, your concerns, your hopes for the future. That's why it's so important to have you by my side for the critical fights ahead – fights we can only win if we win this election first.**
You see, polls show me 1 point behind my GOP opponent, Herschel Walker – who seems to care more about courting favor from Donald Trump than he does about addressing the issues that matter to Georgians. And GOP donors are pouring over $20 MILLION into his campaign to defeat me, so I can't fight back without your help.
**This campaign is fueled entirely by grassroots support. So today, I'm personally asking for your help to power our movement to victory:[Will you chip in $5 now – or however much you can spare, split between me and Jacky Rosen – to help me win in Georgia, defend our Democratic Senate majority, and continue fighting for progress?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/50442642/365903539/-1910320442?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&amount=5&refcode=jtk1989-bu-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODI5OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIyNjI0M2ZjOC00MjMwLWVkMTEtYWU4My0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=KAVSZprwEq36J3sTqo125HtubFZmsKrq94QYLm4023Y=)**

subject: Survey on an urgent matter
body:
I am enclosing a survey on a very urgent matter. It will only take a moment of your time, but the topic is vital to our nation
[View this message in your browser](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z9npt7kj199rflkv1nufohld2ort97ecpd5h5ol0_rp22sh2s8i66or2cth61ob1c9h238h5e8he485he5o75pt7kkpq8ddl69qbcd1jmgr32t5nmepradrmeej3fddnkgp7cc5kmdqjf972u9hfcp76ctj7bcb1e9r62pr4sqqrep5mesqredb269p6fdtlcqoj0p1nc3geap5jc1jt4s3ic9j71cj6e3ib6or7m9p6ccbgmdi6fchkcoqe1cj6c3gbaor0s2qj2cdl66qn49fg)
This sponsored message from American Action News is on behalf of Hillsdale College [](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zloqe6stk0rm9hb7nhdivqqdun0a3lhjbrr3cssg_rp22sh2s8i66or2cth61ob1c9h2bs) Dear Fellow American, I am enclosing a survey on a very urgent matter. It will only take a moment of your time, but the topic is vital to our nation’s future. A movement is growing, led by progressives—but supported by many well-meaning Americans—to change the way we elect our president. In effect, it seeks to do away with the Electoral College as devised by the Framers of our Constitution. That’s why Hillsdale College is conducting a **National Survey on Presidential Selection.** By completing this survey and returning it to me as soon as possible, you will help Hillsdale College more clearly understand the views of mainstream Americans concerning this issue—views we will make available to policymakers and opinion leaders. You can complete the **National Survey on Presidential Selection** by using the link below: **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/electoral-college-survey](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z6i1a3k0n8099mccstcbpu5r0v87n6bun601c2e0_rp22sh2s8i66or2cth61ob1c9h2bs)** For most of our nation’s history, the Electoral College, as devised by the Framers of our Constitution, was not controversial. Indeed, it was considered essential to preserving free and representative government. **But today, more than a dozen states have joined together in an attempt to undermine this constitutional bulwark of liberty.** This movement to undermine the Constitution has grown largely because of the failure of America’s schools to provide young people with a proper grounding in American civics—too many Americans simply don’t understand the importance of the Constitution, including the Electoral College, to liberty. Because of this, Hillsdale College has expanded its educational mission on behalf of liberty nationwide, directly teaching **millions** of Americans in all 50 states. These efforts, which aim to counter the Left’s domination over most of our schools, include:
* **Teaching** millions of citizens nationwide through free online courses, such as “Constitution 101” and “The Great American Story: A Land of Hope;”
* **Reaching** over 5.6 million households and businesses nationwide with _Imprimis_ , Hillsdale’s free digest of liberty;
* **Promoting** constitutional education through social media outlets popular with young people;
* **Sending** millions of pocket-size copies of America’s founding documents to citizens and K-12 schools across America, as well as to members of our armed forces; and
* **Restoring** excellence to K-12 education through Hillsdale’s Barney Charter School Initiative, which launches and provides guidance to classical K-12 charter schools nationwide.

Your answers to the **National Survey on Presidential Selection** will help Hillsdale form the most effective strategy to educate millions of Americans about the importance of the Constitution to liberty—including the importance of the Electoral College. **And this is especially important in this critical time for America’s future.** So please share your views on this urgent topic by completing our **National Survey on Presidential Selection** and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a few minutes of your time. **You can take the survey using this secure link I've provided below:** **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/electoral-college-survey](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zvmq1gq599gichg39kt50jllbhqpbob495aa14a0_rp22sh2s8i66or2cth61ob1c9h2bs)** And after you take your survey, I hope you will also consider supporting Hillsdale College with a tax-deductible gift. Since 1844, Hillsdale has been “pursuing truth and defending liberty.” Today, it does so through its extensive educational outreach efforts, while refusing to accept ONE PENNY of government funding—not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans. The support of private citizens like you is essential to our work. Please represent your state and take the **National Survey on Presidential Selection today**. Thank you for your time and attention—and for your friendship and support of liberty. Warm regards, Larry P. Arnn President, Hillsdale College Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844
---

Because of this, Hillsdale College has expanded its educational mission on behalf of liberty nationwide, directly teaching **millions** of Americans in all 50 states. These efforts, which aim to counter the Left’s domination over most of our schools, include:

Your answers to the **National Survey on Presidential Selection** will help Hillsdale form the most effective strategy to educate millions of Americans about the importance of the Constitution to liberty—including the importance of the Electoral College. **And this is especially important in this critical time for America’s future.** So please share your views on this urgent topic by completing our **National Survey on Presidential Selection** and returning it to me as soon as possible. name: Reclaiming American Freedom
subject: Unlock the Federalist Papers
body:
The events of the last year have no precedent in our nation’s history. This sponsored message from Reclaiming American Freedom is on behalf of Hillsdale College [](http://links.reclamingamericanfreedom.com/u/click?_t=5ec072595b1347f09b4bac0de82ea87d&_m=c3a08a1c8357455e97fcbdb8d03aeed0&_e=aVxbMCXs_UubZH-Wusv9uVj3DYIE7ITryh8MW94sJ7a_eqSzNtAhzgUoDwNUYGMeVJKxSF2R6O5fnHSlZniu3ya00EJACDyzimWFN5CG0T8sk4aOLeMKYwkYzwvFJBgigpMqUF5akR12QFqwA7lCiF0jGKb7KvhVzMKa6V4Ry16cW1Me3dXlwmabxLcr32hi54n-_-O90ng0VDa0Vvs6i-C8PRMBdPaeNpP3PaF59AKz1Tx8x-VYI6iBohexx8pmOQT6LJiH6PyX0pr6L7sSXSETwZBZljgEzmRXq96VFlpcxvN1GvYPyJq9atmRf7YOBQjrOuHMrmETJVKSOZUL7byuIptqdUByy27NAI7HS7FQEIQdXcctGc7_Fuwl4W_-rp41UQdKhiUN99N_RWueMw%3D%3D) Dear Fellow American, The events of the last year have no precedent in our nation’s history. They’ve shaken me, and I’m sure they’ve affected you as well. Throughout it all, you may have noticed a recurring theme from the progressives in the media, Big Tech, and politics. They insist that the government designed by our Founding Fathers, as expressed in the Constitution, is **flawed** and **outdated** —not adequate for the challenges of our time. How should defenders of the Constitution, like you and me, respond to such charges? Well, a few early champions of the Constitution—Alexander Hamilton, John Jay, and James Madison—have given you the guide: _The Federalist Papers_. Written between October 1787 and August 1788 under the pen name Publius, _The Federalist Papers_ were originally published as newspaper editorials intended to explain the merits of the Constitution. Thomas Jefferson described _The Federalist Papers_ as “the best commentary on the principles of government which ever was written.” That means that defenders of the Constitution have no better help in understanding the principles of liberty underlying our Constitution than the words of the Founders themselves. **So, I’d like to send you our entire 10-lesson course, “ _The Federalist Papers_ ,”on DVD today with a donation of $100 or more to Hillsdale College.** _**“The Federalist Papers”**_ course comes in a beautiful DVD box set for viewing in your home or a small group. You might also find it useful for a homeschool curriculum or personal study. It’s taught by Hillsdale’s knowledgeable faculty and will deepen your understanding of this incredibly relevant document even more. The DVD can also make an excellent gift for a friend or family member unfamiliar with our nation’s founding principles of liberty. [](http://links.reclamingamericanfreedom.com/u/click?_t=5ec072595b1347f09b4bac0de82ea87d&_m=c3a08a1c8357455e97fcbdb8d03aeed0&_e=aVxbMCXs_UubZH-Wusv9uVj3DYIE7ITryh8MW94sJ7a_eqSzNtAhzgUoDwNUYGMeVJKxSF2R6O5fnHSlZniu3ya00EJACDyzimWFN5CG0T8sk4aOLeMKYwkYzwvFJBgigpMqUF5akR12QFqwA7lCiF0jGKb7KvhVzMKa6V4Ry16cW1Me3dXlwmabxLcr32hi54n-_-O90ng0VDa0Vvs6i-C8PRMBdPaeNpP3PaF59AKz1Tx8x-VYI6iBohexx8pmZkXLC0XvCnbRmDjPm6w-bXJ6xChF9ru9F81D-PN17gCvqGHhz49mV_K-Xa3b9Eb2GOJN_U3ffnK2r5tNKlDo3UFUEz6drkQuLpPmPrVSGPSxZtY0vFX6fO_ZKpG6R6LPocXrFZMfVLCa8bysju3MNw%3D%3D) Supplies are limited, though, so get this special edition of **_“The Federalist Papers”_** on DVD today. Given that more than 200,000 people have taken this course already, you can bet the DVD box set won’t last long. Click here to learn more about this DVD and order your copy of _**“The Federalist Papers”**_ today: [**https://secured.hillsdale.edu/hillsdale/support-federalist-papers**](http://links.reclamingamericanfreedom.com/u/click?_t=5ec072595b1347f09b4bac0de82ea87d&_m=c3a08a1c8357455e97fcbdb8d03aeed0&_e=aVxbMCXs_UubZH-Wusv9uVj3DYIE7ITryh8MW94sJ7a_eqSzNtAhzgUoDwNUYGMeVJKxSF2R6O5fnHSlZniu3ya00EJACDyzimWFN5CG0T8sk4aOLeMKYwkYzwvFJBgigpMqUF5akR12QFqwA7lCiF0jGKb7KvhVzMKa6V4Ry16cW1Me3dXlwmabxLcr32hi54n-_-O90ng0VDa0Vvs6i-C8PRMBdPaeNpP3PaF59AKz1Tx8x-VYI6iBohexx8pmsHKq_0OgULRtDS1PCNhj0JW5g8__K453pVxQtpl45ux2RXtOcGTHWQ97d1sW8PfpU_y8jw2zEr0yTLGeKLaZjJunP681g51GTpF6qlPCT2rr4UMPjD3WOWlYaAtDgEbLeXI_vPPqstBjgxpzyk4feg%3D%3D) Warm regards, Bill Gray Class of 2001 Associate Vice President of National Donor Outreach Hillsdale College

Friend,

Here's the hard truth: **the Federal Reserve is the culprit behind inflation, the national debt, high taxes, and big government. **

The FED is ROBBING us and secretly stealing our wealth.

It's not enough to Audit the Fed.

**We must abolish the Federal Reserve. **

Let me introduce myself. My name is Sean Themea, chief of staff at Young Americans for Liberty (YAL).

YAL is the nation's largest, most active, and most effective pro-liberty youth organization advancing liberty on campus and in American politics.

And we're fighting to End the Fed.

[_**Friend, the Federal Reserve affects all of us. Can you join the fight to End the Fed and leave a better economy for the next generation? Click here to send a gift of $25, $50, $100, or any amount >>>**_](http://links.conservativelibertywire.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=11dec44cd0e248e6955e0c0beb48b801&_e=4M1yKpOygpyjE8D_vSpY_Y71VVoLeg1JVdPNEE765QOa4SA1KdGzyu4xzTRbbwwAv44t9f0tJWHJoIZl8yS2AwPqVCq5TyKh1_aByRYs2Yxy2wdNvIBk5zcOVDAwcQ94jS48vMBw4u9QwxF3BMfaEyJ6OVSTfWJkhMi70cJbf2TNV8E7HqU9ZNKx-j9MTxBnGlldiAq2R0af_SsTvC7EPmXtiHP2LpuBXyI3IBsXR_1zW-1XefaBZCxaEP2SlKGFkQc6ePterB1F87e0O7FJXw%3D%3D)

YAL was born from Students for Ron Paul.

Ron Paul has advocated for liberty, personal rights, and limited government for decades, and YAL carries the torch on these beliefs.
YAL now recruits and trains students who are tired of socialism, Marxism, and woke policies being pushed on campus.

Last year alone, YAL recruited over 100,000 students!

But our efforts don't stop at college campuses, Friend.

YAL is creating a new infrastructure to win by training thousands of pro-liberty candidates and student activists on how to message the ideas of liberty and how to use the best techniques to win a campaign.

This became Operation Win at the Door. Here's how it works.

* YAL vets legislators and candidates to ensure that they are principled, pro-liberty, and have a history that proves they stand up for YOU and YOUR rights.

* Student activists are trained and deployed across the country. They are sent to key districts to knock doors, drop literature, and make phone calls to fight for freedom.

[](http://links.conservativelibertywire.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=11dec44cd0e248e6955e0c0beb48b801&_e=4M1yKpOygpyjE8D_vSpY_Y71VVoLeg1JVdPNEE765QOa4SA1KdGzyu4xzTRbbwwAv44t9f0tJWHJoIZl8yS2AwPqVCq5TyKh1_aByRYs2Yxy2wdNvIBk5zcOVDAwcQ94e5o-3P6OSuUKkAfQvWyt_UUtwF7FhZlNSLcC9xq8CIZARsrikD8Kloj0IsJoI7oeIxzU32dkWYeTdQIpE9IfcGgGGASowwasggHbe8SDyYBkPzCoM8B08Z7Xu5rSwVjjevjjdHYqW5zraVD_U_tKNA%3D%3D)

And YAL's formula works, Friend.

To date, YAL has built a coalition of more than 250 liberty candidates across the country who are fighting to limit the size and scope of government.

That's why YAL has set a goal for our student activists to reach over 2 million doors in key districts across the country.

**Friend, We have a once-in-a-generation opportunity to radically shift the direction of our country. **

Can I count on you to join the fight and help create a world where the Federal Reserve doesn't exist? **Click below to donate.**

name: Joy Fox
subject: Let's fix housing in RI
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Joy Fox for Congress
body:
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP33/1/95767/images/JF%20email%20banner.png]
Hi Peter,
No matter where I am, the need for more affordable housing is top of mind. Time and again I hear that the cost of renting or buying a home in Rhode Island is simply too high.
There are countless stories. There’s the couple who had to pay six months rent in advance to secure their apartment, and the person looking to buy and realizing they can’t afford–or find–a home. I’ve also heard from business owners who are having a hard time recruiting employees because of a lack of affordable housing.
In a state our size, this is fixable. We also know what works. In Congress, I will make sure Rhode Islanders can live and work here in our state with the following priorities:
Expanding access to first-time home buyers by investing in programs that help with down payments and closing costs.
Increasing rental assistance , including the Housing Choice Voucher program and emergency help for families facing eviction.
Improving the housing supply by bolstering programs such as the Housing Trust Fund and renovating public housing.
I will also focus on having responsive constituent services and bring together community leaders and groups who know what works so we can solve these challenges together to build stronger communities. Please consider donating to my campaign so we can bring this agenda to Washington, D.C. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/joy-fox-for-congress-1]
Thank you,
Joy

---

Like a lot of people, I grew up going to church and had a relationship with God that wasn't especially strong. But as I grew older that changed.

When I started my time at the United States Military Academy, two young men invited me to a Bible study.

They were very intentional to me in explaining God's Word. After some study and discipleship with them, they helped me begin my walk with Christ.

**Since then, faith has been central to my life.** I keep a Bible open on my desk, and read every morning from the Good Book.

---
| [](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61232251:Js7HnvVNL:m:1:3253819041:CB1242CE51310FE8251BDCB1B6E947E7:r)
---

Like you, I am also confronted with a highly complex set of problems, and I need the wisdom to try and make the right calls. _**So I need my mind renewed with the truth of the Gospel each day.**_

Unfortunately, faith-driven judgments are few and far between in Washington. Our leaders act without moral clarity and the consequences have been devastating.

If we are to restore honesty, integrity, and morality to our government, __**[we must elect more faith-driven leaders.](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61232251:Js7HnvVNL:m:1:3253819041:CB1242CE51310FE8251BDCB1B6E947E7:r "we must elect more

| | | Friend,

I have never seen the Left more aggressive and out of control as they are in the last few days and weeks. Long gone are the days of polite discourse, the days when we could have disagreements without it ending in riots and chaos. Not only is the left posting the personal addresses of SCOTUS members on Twitter, but in Washington DC, activists are giving cash to restaurants to "out" SCOTUS members if they dine in.

I knew when I announced my campaign for re-election that this would be a campaign unlike one I've ever seen before, and it has. The vitriol and slander I've seen so far this year has never been paralleled.

The days of decorum have disappeared, but can and need to return. And that's why I'm running for re-election. Democrats have let major cities become crime ridden, they are behind the rising inflation we are experiencing at the pump and grocery stores, and this is just the beginning of their mayhem.

This is not a landscape that I want our children and grandchildren growing up in. I will always fight for their future, and I hope if you stand with me in that fight you'll stand with me right now in this campaign.

I hate asking for money - it's my least favorite thing to do. But the facts are simple. Democrats across the country are gearing up to make this Wisconsin Senate race the most expensive in history in an attempt to not just defeat me, but defeat our values and beliefs.

No donation is too small. $5 makes a difference. $5 can help us reach that one undecided voter and ensure they get out and vote and keep WI red.

I know our nation's brightest days are ahead of us, but getting there isn't going to be easy. _**[We can win in November if I can count on your support right now.](http://links.defend-the-constitution.org/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=fc3fa32574f34cabade96434f7fc92e5&_e=szV7yo31ZEOk6I90y8TUbO41Wsvm9ttg1_5QPvTe2IciH9TP0ma7jeF-_JJEh6a1-24AZIw9TjjBAmrnFUpOiv6MBSoeLjp8xVniBs-nRl_71iKsYCf4NfHNjGmTMhly3CZRD37fW6rt5-ikXHgYoc_oHHTJE2OG8u3p1gco0fib93KKZvb1Xln1QwLxpoHwSQU7_uAKh7uWogJsGksvHkQf6KXoBNIY5fcc14rhQkQdDfa_xLZvnDm7RousFa7HtLL_dmPwrOT8hAiPWTmmUpso_AzsuEiLKyAFjVicGDioL4B4VavuDukld5_udBVbXaZRTAgVfTtY7z6NPBrOmtrQeuupr-mfnArJc9X5v2TRAoKv4uS9JELvtn29fAedU62FLg6f3lRT160-a76zKPRDzyzmnKDVyEvRfGbpTZs%3D "Johnson1")**_

Despite all this: _**Yes, there is hope for the future**_.

_What if I told you the thing that gives me the MOST hope are our college students?_ You’d think I was crazy. Aren’t they all radicals too?

name: Delegate Jazz Lewis
subject: I hope you enjoyed your Labor Day weekend! Here's what I have been up to!
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Friends of Jazz Lewis
body:
Hi Folks,
I hope you enjoyed this Labor Day weekend! Labor Day was created to honor workers memorializing the rise of American labor unions in the 19th century. I began my career as a union organizer, and with the recent rise of American workers unionizing, the meaning of Labor Day has never been more important.
I recently visited the International Union of Painters and Allied Trades, to learn more about glazing, and how it helps our homes and businesses with energy efficiency. Empowering labor unions has been at the core of my my work as delegate.
To make sure the General Assembly can continue that work, I have been working to help my Democratic colleagues in Maryland succeed in the General Election.
An important part of empowering our labor force is investing in the future, our students. Last month, I partnered with Mayor Cross of Glenarden on a school supply giveaway event, and supported the back to school community day hosted by the town of Capitol Heights. I also met with my office's annual scholarship recipients to discuss their future plans and how I can support their professional futures.
I am always looking for new ways to support my constituents and solve our most pressing issues. Please do not hesitate to reach out to my office or reply to this email, if ------

body:
| |
---
| | | | [](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61228748:6zkNtvVkN:m:1:3334294963:4B537D1F4B7E23D8008D6C43D1CBC4A5:r)

Our conception of community and of our nation is being threatened.

**That is why it is up to people of faith to lead our country back to the path of righteousness.**

Christians must restore our notion of character to our country and our world. The proclamation of faith is paramount.

We Christians need to communicate our belief that everyone is endowed with dignity that must be respected because we all bear the mark of the Creator.

This principle is the means to bring our divided country together without hatred or bitterness.

---
| [](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61228748:6zkNtvVkN:m:1:3334294963:4B537D1F4B7E23D8008D6C43D1CBC4A5:r)

It is with this understanding and respect for our past that we must once again openly profess our faith and our devotion to our families, and proclaim unapologetically the words, **" I am a Christian and I am an American."**

**If you think faith will put America back on track,__[please sign my petition today.](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61228748:6zkNtvVkN:m:1:3334294963:4B537D1F4B7E23D8008D6C43D1CBC4A5:r "please sign my

name: Cheri Beasley
subject: humbling
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Gillibrand for Senate
body:
Hi there,
First and foremost, I want to say thank you to everybody who has supported our grassroots campaign. I am so grateful to the more than 100,000 people who have helped us get to where we are - less than 2 months from making history. It is humbling.
The truth is I’m reaching out with a request today because we have an important FEC fundraising deadline at the end of this month. Will you please consider making a contribution to our grassroots campaign to help us hit our ambitious goal? Please use this link to give:
secure.actblue.com/contribute/page/beasley_gfs [http://secure.actblue.com/contribute/page/beasley_gfs?refcode=jtk3642-bu-nd]
We’re heading into the final stretch of this campaign. Right after Labor Day, everything kicked into an even higher gear. Senate Republicans’ outside spending is going to increase by millions of dollars.
Look, their super PACs can spend millions on false attack ads against me, like they’re doing right now. But I refuse to back down because this seat and our next Senator’s vote should not be for sale.
My opponent Ted Budd thinks he can just let special interests buy this seat for him, and in return, he’ll continue doing exactly what he’s done in Congress — voting to keep the system rigged in favor of billionaires and corporations. He will fight for a future where abortion is banned in every state, where marriage equality is overturned, and where economic inequality only gets worse.
I’m running this race to be a voice for people just like you. I will not accept a future where our children have fewer rights than we did. We cannot go backward. I will never hesitate to do what is right in the U.S. Senate — justice for the people will be my North Star.
But the truth is I simply cannot do this alone.
So I’m humbly asking you to split a $15 contribution to our campaign and Kirsten Gillibrand today to help us flip this seat and expand our Senate majority. Our end-of-quarter FEC deadline is almost here, and it is critical that we reach our goal and raise the resources necessary to compete with the super PACs trying to buy this seat. subject: Email Town Hall Follow-up
body:
You’ll recall that the other day, we sent around an “email town hall” asking for you to submit questions.
| | |
---
Derek,

It’s hard to believe the summer is over. And what a summer it was. My team and I have been busy meeting with folks here in PA-06, getting the chance to talk to constituents, and hearing your concerns, which all help as I fight for you in Washington. You’ll recall that the other day, we sent around an “email town hall” asking for you to submit questions. Well, we got a bunch, and I’m excited to answer some here.
**1\. Do you support a woman’s right to choose (abortion)?**

**_YES!_** I am standing up to the GOP politicians who want to ban abortion by advancing the Women’s Health Protection Act to make Roe the law of the land, standing against efforts to defund Planned Parenthood, and working to improve maternal health care access through the Maternal Health Quality Improvement Act.
**2. ****I would love a bullet point summary of the Inflation Reduction Act and how to explain it to my neighbors.**

Great question. The Inflation Reduction Act does several terrific things that will help working families and lower costs in a bunch of ways. Here are just a few:
* Lowers the cost of prescription drugs by enabling Medicare to negotiate prices with drug companies, capping annual out-of-pocket costs at $2,000, and capping the price of insulin at $35 per month for Medicare recipients.
* Lowers health care costs by reducing premiums.
* Lowers utility costs for families by providing rebates and tax credits to make homes and vehicles more energy efficient.
* Makes overdue investments in the IRS to modernize its outdated system, which will make it much easier for average citizens to file their taxes and reclaim their refunds.
* Doesn’t raise taxes on anyone making less than $400,000 a year while ensuring that America’s largest and most profitable corporations, those making over $1 billion annually, pay something on that income by implementing a 15% minimum corporate tax.
* Leads us towards durable energy independence by investing in clean energy production here at home, putting the US on track to reduce 40% of carbon emissions by 2030.
* Accomplishes these goals while reducing the deficit by hundreds of billions of dollars.

**3. ****I am very concerned about attacks on our democratic institutions and our voting rights. If election-deniers are elected, they intend to nullify fair and just elections. If that happens, our democracy is finished. What is being done to protect voting rights all the way through the certification of elections?**
Election denialism is dangerous. First and foremost, we need leaders to speak the truth and accept the results of fair and just elections. That means we need to continue to elect pro-democracy officials up and down the ballot. Furthermore, we have legislative work to do – from fixing the Electoral Count Act to ending gerrymandering and enacting campaign finance reform, I am leading efforts in Congress to ensure that our government is responsive to you.
**4\. What are Democrats doing to make sure we hold the House and get a majority in the Senate this midterm election?**
This is a great question. We need to do two things: 1.) make sure voters know we are fighting for them, and 2.) ensure that the stakes of the radical MAGA agenda are made clear to voters. To the first point, we need to make sure that our community knows that we are delivering for them. We are working to address inflation by fixing supply chains and lowering costs for families, improving our schools, and keeping our communities safe. On the other hand, MAGA Republicans are offering a dangerous agenda that would strip away our rights and freedoms and erode our democracy. The vast majority of our community – Republicans, Democrats, and Independents – is on our side on both of these issues
The excitement that I feel when I’m advocating for you gets a little stronger knowing the issues you care deeply about. But we have a big fight ahead: **The GOP is going all out to flip this seat red and the NRCC just added it to their target list.** But I know we can win if we continue to work together and spread our message of positivity and progress. [**So please, can you donate $5 so we can power our movement to victory?**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/50458445/365962227/685235109?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&amount=5&refcode=jtk658-fr-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDIvMS82NDkxMyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI0NmQzNTUyNi01OTMwLWVkMTEtYWU4My0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=GCnYyicyq7BrJZO99QgaScZujkknm48mluzgbVhv4v0=)
Thank you, Derek. There is work to be done, and I'm so glad you're with me.

Chrissy

**But it also tells the story of all of you.** Western Pennsylvania is the kind of place where you step up to help your neighbors and make sure nobody is left behind. But I see mega corporations and corrupt politicians more than willing to leave our community in the dust. __And it pisses me off.__

**But we’re fighting back, Derek. I’m ready to take on unchecked corporate power, fight to make more stuff right here at home with union workers, and do the work to bring down costs for working families.**

[**I need your help to spread this message to voters throughout western PA and to fight back against the GOP’s vicious and untruthful attack ads. We are in a neck-and-neck race – in our last poll, there was only one point separating me and my opponent – so it’s critical that we talk to as many folks as possible. This ad will allow me to spread my message about fighting for our common good to every corner of western Pennsylvania. This ad tells the story of me. When I served our country in Iraq and at sea. When I helped secure our elections after our voting rights came under attack. And now, when I’m stepping up to help lead western PA through the economic fight of our lives. But it also tells the story of all of you. Western Pennsylvania is the kind of place where you step up to help your neighbors and make sure nobody is left behind. But I see mega corporations and corrupt politicians more than willing to leave our community in the dust. And it pisses me off. But we’re fighting back, Derek. I’m ready to take on unchecked corporate power, fight to make more stuff right here at home with union workers, and do the work to bring down costs for working families. = Thank you, Chris | | Chris Deluzio is a voting rights lawyer and Iraq war veteran running for Congress in Pennsylvania's 17th District.
