subject: Why I created the BLEXIT Foundation
body:
This is the most personal and vulnerable email I have ever sent you... But I must share my story and tell you why I created the
[View this message in your browser](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zojmos1khvam6dp05ageb8ijo3afrmeb53jftej8_rp2ash2s8gb2sbgebjqf99jkgqracjkmoq37d1m65qbfctjmkrncst66uqrf91ieoob9crl6uie5sj2u8oecc9imeqe0pj0s1r78ddhehoracpmcdh31pplchp78shj63jjadjjctin5c77q9o74oj6e2p6cs74mdhmfcjicooneddgsur62phmc2p6co70mlhm1o5l64oracdle8gq48bi4bh28or3c9jm2p30chge49fg)
[](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zaebtd104imdph2j28m6cj443inrmr6ns044bne8_rp22sh2s8i66or2ctgm8o34c3h2bs)

Friend,

This is the most personal and vulnerable email I have ever sent you... But I must share my story and tell you why I created the BLEXIT Foundation.

Before I share my story, allow me to introduce the BLEXIT Foundation.

**For too long, I have watched Black Americans force-fed a message of victimhood, fear, defeat, and dependence. And, this has to stop.** In 2019, with Brandon Tatum, we created BLEXIT Foundation - a nonprofit organization - dedicated to bringing traditional American principles and a message of empowerment to urban minority communities.

Our message to America's black and minority communities is that you are not a victim. We promote economic independence and individual freedom, strengthening the nuclear family, and fostering a deeper appreciation for patriotism in Black American culture.

[_**Please support the BLEXIT Foundation 's mission today by helping me reach our goal of raising $25,000 from new online donors. You can click here to donate.**_](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zahoaru5r0hd4nuh1q8qlbfkh6d468sc4kstbc1o_rp22sh2s8i66or2ctgm8o34c3h2bs)

**_Now I 'll share my story_... racism, death threats, and empowering black communities.**

Growing up as a black woman, I can recall learning how "helpless" I was told I was. And this message - which the media forces Black Americans to listen to - is heartbreaking.

We're taught to believe we're victims, that nothing will ever change, the police are our enemies, and racism prevents us from ever achieving our goals.

This is WRONG.

I've dealt with racism... _**I 've even received death threats**_. Racism is an ugly form of collectivism and is unacceptable.

But the solution is NOT to become a victim and give up.

I created the BLEXIT Foundation to empower black communities, minorities, and the people in my life whom I love. Since our start in 2019, BLEXIT has grown substantially with over 41 grassroots chapter programs in 41 states, over 14,000 volunteer members and local community leaders, and nearly 60,000 grassroots supporters.

[_**Friend, I am inviting you to support the BLEXIT Foundation and help us spread our winning message of entrepreneurship, school choice, faith, and family. My goal is to raise $25,000 from online supporters to fund our mission. Please click here to donate $10, $50, $100, $250, $500, $1,000 or any amount. **_](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z6h09jqd9g8tv33v2bfbphkqeegoousvojkt3huo_rp22sh2s8i66or2ctgm8o34c3h2bs)

I am breaking the rules.

It seems like every email I receive in my inbox engages in fear-mongering, makes big promises, and demands you and I make a donation without any of the details... _I 'm not doing that_.

You should know the details, believe in our mission, and understand how BLEXIT is changing the direction of our urban communities and our country.

So I am taking a risk by sending you a long email with all the details to empower YOU to choose to support the BLEXIT Foundation.**Please read to the end of this email (I have an important message at the end you don 't want to miss).**

When I founded BLEXIT, I wanted to make sure above all else we were NOT just a "think tank", but rather we pride ourselves on being a thoughtful and quick acting "DO-tank". We're doing things no other organization in the country is doing.

Here are the BLEXIT Foundation's values, what we're doing to reach Black communities, and what we're fighting for:

* **School Choice:** Often, the people allegedly "fighting for minorities" are doing everything in their power to keep Black and Hispanic students locked into awful schools.

The ugly truth is that these schools are simply brainwashing centers attacking the nuclear family, creating victims, and teaching their twisted values. BLEXIT is fighting for School Choice to empower young Black and Hispanic students to learn real skills, have more opportunities, and escape poverty. [_**You can support BLEXIT 's efforts to fight for School Choice here >>>**_](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zd260ilsenhuct4nqf8jhloq002e0f6kp1q4f0m0_rp22sh2s8i66or2ctgm8o34c3h2bs)

* **Criminal Justice Reform:** The mainstream media wants urban communities to hate our law enforcement officers. This ugly message is setting Black Americans back. The BLEXIT Foundation supports our men and women who serve as police officers and defend our communities.

Yes, we do need criminal justice reform. But we believe cooperating with our police officers and connecting as a community is critical to creating justice. BLEXIT Foundation is starting conversations with police officers and urban communities. The media wants you to believe cops are evil! This is wrong. But people never hear this message.

[_**Help the BLEXIT Foundation change the narrative by making a donation here >>>**_](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zqr9baauunba24p2tk37bk6ce9kgfrl8e08vnlug_rp22sh2s8i66or2ctgm8o34c3h2bs)

* **Entrepreneurship:** I am passionate about empowering Black and Hispanic Americans. Free markets, responsibility, and advancing the careers of urban communities is the solution to poverty. The BLEXIT Foundation identifies young leaders in urban communities and helps them create resumes, practice interviews, and learn skills employers desire.

BLEXIT is not a book club or simply talking a big game... No, we're actually making an impact with real individuals committed to serving urban communities. [_**Please help the BLEXIT Foundation encourage entrepreneurship and empower Black and Hispanic communities by donating here >>>**_](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zo0v8gej89u02o8hkddatp4g56vq5o36rm2191sg_rp22sh2s8i66or2ctgm8o34c3h2bs)

* **Teaching History: **Critical Race Theory has nothing to do with solving race relations in our country. This is about division and spreading a victimhood message.

The BLEXIT Foundation believes in teaching real American history. It is critical for our urban communities to learn about our Founding Fathers and the Constitution to become productive and educated citizens. [_**Please help the BLEXIT Foundation teach real American history by donating here >>>**_](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z7moq3v7nmqnus2mavvu38f5dbpevmv64luie4m0_rp22sh2s8i66or2ctgm8o34c3h2bs)

* **Presenting Our Message: **We have failed to reach urban communities with our message and values. Instead, we've allowed the mainstream media to write the narrative. Not anymore.

The BLEXIT Foundation is going places where no one else goes. We're hosting events in Detroit, Baltimore, and Tampa and starting real conversations. We're not just preaching to the choir, and these aren't boring events. They have music, art, and real conversations, and they are fun! I am committed to reaching urban communities and spreading our message. [_**Please support BLEXIT 's events and help us spread our message by donating here >>>**_](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2ziouec4jmo6hqaf05bo87mg6inlthbt3ih01ulh0_rp22sh2s8i66or2ctgm8o34c3h2bs)

What does "BLEXIT" mean? BLEXIT is the Black exit from the culture of victimhood, fear, and dependence the media has forced on us. If you hold a permanent view of yourself as a victim you become your own oppressor.

This is personal to me.

I was once a slave to a culture of victimhood and became a proud Black patriot.

But I must share my story and tell you why I created the BLEXIT Foundation. Before I share my story, allow me to introduce the BLEXIT Foundation. For too long, I have watched Black Americans force-fed a message of victimhood, fear, defeat, and dependence. And, this has to stop. In 2019, with Brandon Tatum, we created BLEXIT Foundation - a nonprofit organization - dedicated to bringing traditional American principles and a message of empowerment to urban minority communities. Our message to America's black and minority communities is that you are not a victim. We promote economic independence and individual freedom, strengthening the nuclear family, and fostering a deeper appreciation for patriotism in Black American culture. Now I 'll share my story... racism, death threats, and empowering black communities. Growing up as a black woman, I can recall learning how "helpless" I was told I was. And this message - which the media forces Black Americans to listen to - is heartbreaking. We're taught to believe we're victims, that nothing will ever change, the police are our enemies, and racism prevents us from ever achieving our goals. This is WRONG. I've dealt with racism... I 've even received death threats. Racism is an ugly form of collectivism and is unacceptable. But the solution is NOT to become a victim and give up. I created the BLEXIT Foundation to empower black communities, minorities, and the people in my life whom I love. Since our start in 2019, BLEXIT has grown substantially with over 41 grassroots chapter programs in 41 states, over 14,000 volunteer members and local community leaders, and nearly 60,000 grassroots supporters. I am breaking the rules. It seems like every email I receive in my inbox engages in fear-mongering, makes big promises, and demands you and I make a donation without any of the details... The ugly truth is that these schools are simply brainwashing centers attacking the nuclear family, creating victims, and teaching their twisted values. BLEXIT is fighting for School Choice to empower young Black and Hispanic students to learn real skills, have more opportunities, and escape poverty. Criminal Justice Reform: The mainstream media wants urban communities to hate our law enforcement officers. This ugly message is setting Black Americans back. The BLEXIT Foundation supports our men and women who serve as police officers and defend our communities. Yes, we do need criminal justice reform. But we believe cooperating with our police officers and connecting as a community is critical to creating justice. BLEXIT Foundation is starting conversations with police officers and urban communities. The media wants you to believe cops are evil! This is wrong. But people never hear this message. Entrepreneurship: I am passionate about empowering Black and Hispanic Americans. Free markets, responsibility, and advancing the careers of urban communities is the solution to poverty. # ‘Drain the Swamp?’: Lawmakers From Both Parties Are Too Afraid to Do What It Would Really Take
[Townhall](https://mattmowers.us4.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0b9f631aa1029b60ed9a5731f&id=4b59384fcf&e=ee27ab5035) 9/9/22
Matt Mowers
---
| | Come campaign season, you’ll hear politicians on both sides insist that they want to go to change Washington – or even “Drain the Swamp.” For the sake of our families and small businesses, we need to reverse the course of destruction Joe Biden and Congressional Democrats have created, but we can’t do it without taking on Members of Congress and their corrupt stock trades.

Democrats – and even some Republicans – shy away from talking about this. Perhaps that’s because a [list](https://mattmowers.us4.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0b9f631aa1029b60ed9a5731f&id=121e64de59&e=ee27ab5035) includes dozens of Members from both parties of violating the laws we have on the books specifically to prevent insider trading by our elected representatives. If we’re serious about draining the D.C. Swamp, one of the first things a new Congress facing the Biden administration needs to do is to ban Members of Congress and their spouses from trading stocks.

Are all violations malicious? Of course not, but as stewards of the public’s trust, our elected officials should go out of their way to avoid even the appearance of impropriety—and this shouldn’t be hard. It’s a privilege to serve constituents and protect their interests.

The bottom line is that there are far too many opportunities for elected officials to learn about sensitive, nonpublic matters that could be used to enhance a stock portfolio: information shared among colleagues away from news cameras, closed door committee hearings, classified intelligence briefings.

Speaker of the House Nancy Pelosi is one of the biggest offenders. Weeks before a crucial vote on the industry, her husband Paul [sunk millions into a computer chip company](https://mattmowers.us4.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0b9f631aa1029b60ed9a5731f&id=9205606d14&e=ee27ab5035) that would have benefited handsomely from the eventual bill. Only once his trades became public was he forced to sell them at a loss, but don’t worry: Paul Pelosi has also made millions off of Alphabet and Microsoft stocks conveniently timed with news events that were material to changes in the stock price. Are we really supposed to believe this is a coincidence?

We shouldn’t have to wonder. There’s a reason why trust in our public institutions is at an all-time low; our public officials are more interested in enriching themselves than they are about solving the real-world problems Americans are facing affording basics like gas and food or fighting crime in their communities. Public service is a privilege – and not the right too many of these D.C. politicians have come to expect it to be.

Unfortunately, for the public – and to the great benefit of the offending lawmakers – the House Ethics Committee, which is charged with policing these violations likely will not meet to resolve these issues until after Election Day. That means for politicians who have flagrantly abused the system, they essentially have a “Get Out of Jail Free” card to bring home with them to the campaign trail. This doesn’t surprise me; from my time in the Trump administration, I have seen firsthand the lengths to which bureaucrats will go to cling to power and thwart new ideas.

It does mean, however, that a new Congress has a unique opportunity to start cleaning house. Congress should not only thoroughly investigate and penalize the bad actors, but it should also be focused from Day 1 about prohibiting these corrupt practices from the start. Rebuilding trust with the American people will not be an easy task, but we can start with a bold message that Congress is out of the self-serving, corrupt stock trading business that rewards insiders at the public’s expense.

_Matt Mowers served as Senior White House Advisor in the U.S. Department of State in the Trump Administration and was the 2020 Republican Nominee in New Hampshire’s 1 st Congressional District_

body:
Thank you for everything, and a request for the path ahead
Dear Friend**,**
_Thank you._
When I launched my improbable, history-making campaign for Congress in 2019, I could not have imagined the support I would receive from all corners of our nation. Sometimes, I have to pinch myself. Growing up poor, Black, and closeted, I never imagined someone like me could run for Congress, let alone get elected and deliver for working families like my own.
I'm so proud to be part of the most productive Congress in modern history, as the youngest member of House leadership and the most legislatively active freshman member of Congress.
This term, Democrats passed the American Rescue Plan, which brought us back from the brink of economic calamity, cut child poverty in half, and vaccinated our nation in the midst of a deadly pandemic. My proudest legislative achievement was the key role I played in bringing progressives and conservative Democrats together to pass the Infrastructure Investment and Jobs Act, the largest investment in our nation’s infrastructure in history.
Recently, I was elated to pass the CHIPS Act, which will lower the price of goods through addressing our supply chain crisis, and the Inflation Reduction Act, which will reduce our carbon emissions by 40 percent by the year 2030 and cap the annual cost of prescription drugs for millions of seniors like my grandmother.
I'm also proud of what our grassroots movement has done in the midst of legislative gridlock. Last summer, I helped lead a successful effort to convince President Biden to extend the national eviction moratorium, which saved lives, and recently helped convince him to cancel student debt to liberate an entire generation of young people to meaningfully participate in our economy while closing the racial wealth gap.
During my first campaign, I ran on all of these policies. And we got them done.
But there is so much more work to be done. Our democracy is in crisis. The next Congress must pass legislation that I co-authored, and which the House passed, called the Freedom to Vote: John R. Lewis Act.
I deeply regret that I will not be returning to the House next year. Redistricting in New York has been a nightmare, and an abject failure for Democrats.
As I determine how to be most impactful next year, I’m also focused on what matters now: keeping our majority in the House and growing it in the Senate.
_Our democracy, and the progressive legislation we want to see enacted, depend on it._
With your support over the past couple of years, I established Policy is Personal PAC to aid my House and Senate colleagues in holding and expanding our Democratic majorities while getting more diverse, progressive voices elected to Congress.
Policy is Personal has contributed hundreds of thousands of dollars to Democrats fighting fascism across the country, and will continue to do so over the next couple of months. This cycle, Policy is Personal has succeeded in helping House candidates such as Max Frost (FL-10), Delia Ramirez (IL-03), Greg Casar (TX-35), Jill Tokuda (HI-02), Eric Sorensen (IL-17), Robert Garcia (CA-42), and Will Rollins (CA-41), as well as Senate candidates like Mandela Barnes (Wisconsin) and Val Demings (Florida), win their primaries.

| FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASEContact:James ManetzJames@BryceReeves.com
---
| Senator Bryce Reeves Joins Governor Glenn Youngkin for Historic Veterans Bill Ceremonial Signing
---
| FREDERICKSBURG, VA – September 9, 2022 – Today, Senator Bryce Reeves (R-Spotsylvania) joined Governor Glenn Youngkin (R-Virginia) and Virginia Secretary of Veterans and Defense Affairs Craig Crenshaw to sign his historic bill, SB528, into law. SB528, which will offer individual income tax exemptions to service members and surviving spouses age 55 and older that receive military retirement benefits, is the first of its kind to be codified into law in the Commonwealth of Virginia. Bryce Reeves stated, “During my time as a Senator, I have consistently worked to make Virginia the most veteran-friendly state in the country. Today marks a big step toward achieving that goal to attract and retain the best of the best talent that our country produces. When it comes to those who wear the cloth of our country and risk their lives for our freedom, you will find the Virginia legislature standing shoulder to shoulder with all of us stepping up to do our very best. I’d like to thank the 27 plus veteran service organizations and the Joint Leadership Council (JLC) who helped to get this bill passed. I’d also be remiss if I didn’t personally thank my teammates from the General Assembly Military and Veterans Caucus (GAMVC), who made this a priority alongside members of both chambers serving on Senate Finance and House Appropriations. Washington should look to our Commonwealth to see how to get good, bipartisan legislation passed.” Senator Reeves has received an outpouring of support from veterans communities throughout Virginia, and today's event saw high attendance from Veterans of Foreign Wars (VFW), American Veterans Vote (AVV), American Legion, Military Officers Association of America (MOAA), and Women Marines Association (WMA) members and leadership. The Senator's past work on veterans issues includes the inception of Veterans Treatment Dockets, designed to offer service members a second chance when interacting with the courts systems and connecting them to the mental health, employment, and housing opportunities they might need. His work extends to the national level as Co-Chair of the National Conference of State Legislators Task Force on Military and Veterans Affairs, where members of state legislative bodies around the country collaborate in order to effectively deal with veterans issues at home.
---
| ###
---
| Bryce Reeves is a small business owner, auxiliary sheriff's deputy in Culpeper County, former Army Ranger, and former Prince William County narcotics detective. He currently represents the 17th District in the Virginia Senate, which includes the City of Fredericksburg and the Counties of Albemarle (part), Culpeper (part), Louisa (part), Orange, and Spotsylvania (part). Senator Reeves serves on the Senate Committee on Rehabilitation and Social Services and sits on the Committees on Local Government, General Laws and Technology, and Privileges and Elections. In addition, Senator Reeves is Co-chair of the Virginia General Assembly Military and Veterans Caucus. Senator Reeves resides in Spotsylvania County.

So I thought it important to reach out and explain why every American should be extraordinarily thankful that the FBI recovered the materials from Trump.
During my time in the military, I held clearance to handle some of the more sensitive materials we had, including those marked Top Secret / SCI. Sources (people) and methods (expensive) — to be protected.
Any materials with those classifications have potential to inflict a great amount of damage to the United States, in the wrong hands. Not only would your military career be over if you stole those materials, you could at least be looking at a very long time in prison.
It strains all credulity to argue Donald Trump didn’t know he took TS/SCI material. These are materials that very few can see, and even then, must view them in secure facilities. They’re not papers in the bottom of your junk drawer.
We still do not know if these were nuclear documents, or something else. But it doesn’t matter. TS/SCI classification is deadly serious, and Donald Trump taking them makes him a national security threat.

The 2020 race for Pennsylvania’s 7th Congressional District was a narrow one, with Democrat Susan Wild winning by just a few points. ** ** This year, we have a chance to flip this seat and elect conservative leader Lisa Scheller. ** ** Lisa is committed to empowering parents, securing our nation's border, and standing up to woke cancel culture. She’s the granddaughter of immigrants and CEO of a manufacturing company. With her experience she knows the value of the dollar and hard work. If elected to Pennsylvania’s 7th Congressional District, she will create jobs and grow the economy. ** ** [**That is why Lisa Scheller has earned my official endorsement for Pennsylvania's 7th Congressional District. Let's be clear, if the Democratic Party's official position is to oppose the influence of dark money in politics, they should have no problem passing this resolution to ban dark money in primaries.

Dems can't be the Party of democracy in one breath and then allow an astronomical amount of money from Republican megadonors and corporate interests to flood Democratic primaries.

Despite the onslaught of dark money, progressives clinched critical wins in the 2022 primaries - folks like Greg Casar (TX-35), Summer Lee (PA-12), and many others are headed to Congress and building a progressive bench down-ballot.

But, we also saw sudden waves of cash drown districts with false smears against some of our most beloved candidates, leading to heartbreaking losses and erasing 30-point leads in the campaign's final weeks.

This is abhorrent and anti-democratic. It cannot stand, and Democrats have an opportunity to change it.

**_[Can you chip in ASAP so we can send as many calls as possible to DNC members showing them that Democratic voters want to pass this resolution and Ban Dark Money from the primaries?](https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/7577?refcode=OR_EM_FR_40SP_20220909_1_3&t=15&akid=3363%2E5885482%2EN-Ecq4)_**

In solidarity,

Our Revolution

I wish I could say winning this race will be easy, friend – but Republicans will stop at nothing to take back the Senate, and I'm getting worried. **Here's what I'm up against:**
Marco Rubio and the Senate Republican campaign arm raised a combined **$105 million** in _just the last few months,_ and deep-pocketed Republican megadonors aren't going to stop pouring money into the race for Senate control.
**$600 million**. That's the astronomical amount expected to be spent on political ads in Florida – which would make this the most expensive Senate race EVER.
And right now, I'm falling **187 Florida Defenders short** of what I need to keep pace. If I can't meet my goal, I won't have the critical resources I need to win. And with our majority hanging on by just ONE seat, that means we're at risk of Mitch McConnell regaining Senate control.

On Wednesday, a Michigan state court sided with the people and declared the state's 1931 abortion ban - _which would 've made life-saving abortion procedures a felony offense_ - unconstitutional.

Here's the bottom line: Since the Trump-appointed Supreme Court overturned _Roe v. Wade_ , it's time for us to take our outrage to the ballot box this November and say NO to dangerous bans.

**[Derek has always been guided by the principle that decisions about health care should be made between a person and their doctor. Instead of following the will of the people, these extremists want to pick and choose who wins elections.
It’s unlike anything I’ve ever seen.

body:
There’s this notion nowadays that just because an idea is popular, it must be true.
[View this message in your browser](http://e.deroymurdock.com/rd/9z2zqa0am48oear7ult2qadg21hqf45ra6nfs5fb690_rp22sh2s8i66or2ctim0o34c5h238h5e8he485he5o75pt7kkpq2d9ieuqfbdbie4rrcdljkorrbdt469r31d5jekrq9onicbom0thmc4obfc77m5r70sbks1ij2ohje1p7eohle5or4ttj6kon4d1lccp68phnmv970sj46oob4pjiegonco70mhij1o5l65iecpj664ob6p9ge8o6cd34mdh6fc5lclp2bs)

| | | [](http://e.deroymurdock.com/rd/9z2z95rr55nrruvddi818rlmnn6maocv0bskqqhvg0o_rp22sh2s8i66or2ctim0o34c5h2bs)
---
| | Dear Friend, There's this notion nowadays that just because an idea is popular, it must be true.

It's a narrative that you'll often see pushed by a dysfunctional media or toxic culture. And as long as the idea is considered "correct" by the "right" people like TV talking heads, celebrities, or the masses on social media, the general public believes it.

That's why the Libertas Institute published this eBook in our Tuttle Twins series: **[_The Tuttle Rebuttals: 40 Responses to Popular Political and Economic Myths._](http://e.deroymurdock.com/rd/9z2z6f3boa3a6g0lhefqegj70i8kkoic17mei7fn02o_rp22sh2s8i66or2ctim0o34c5h2bs)**
---
| [](http://e.deroymurdock.com/rd/9z2z3rmcjm2fmohpucjr8d3qjtg30mqvako4bac9148_rp22sh2s8i66or2ctim0o34c5h2bs)
---
| | And today, we want to send a copy to your inbox for FREE.

Inside this important eBook, you'll get a clear analysis of some of the biggest political and economic myths infecting our world today like:
* Overpopulation is destroying the world
* Global climate change can be reversed by law
* Capitalism creates winners and losers
* Socialism helps the poor

Hi Derek, my name is Charlie Crist, and I just became the
Democratic nominee for governor of Florida.

My opponent? Gov. Ron DeSantis, one of the most dangerous Republicans
nationwide.

Ron DeSantis has been using Florida as a testing ground for some of the
most cruel and divisive culture war tactics of the last two years. He has
been setting himself up as a likely presidential contender, and it’s been
working.

DeSantis signed one of the first vile “Don’t Say Gay” bills. He attacked
Disney and the Special Olympics when they opposed his policies. He’s even
created an “elections police” unit that people fear will be more about
voter intimidation than voter protection.

[ https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1014?c0=sep2022_abs_em_crist.hG56br&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_TAN_GEN_AC_20220909_AM1_V1_S1&email=&t=1005&akid=844%2E5257348%2ENmamRm ]DeSantis’s next act is to run for president in 2024, and that’s why I’m
writing to you today. This election is our last, best chance to stop Gov.
DeSantis’s national ambitions and get Florida back on track. We can
accomplish both by defeating him on November 8th, so I hope you’ll make a
contribution today to split between my campaign for governor and my friend
Adam Schiff’s efforts to defend our Democratic House majority.

If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your split
donation to Charlie Crist and Adam Schiff will go through immediately:

By using the governorship as a stepping stone to run for president in
2024, DeSantis has shown he doesn’t have Florida’s best interests at
heart.

But I’ve always put Floridians first. From my time as a state senator to
serving as Florida’s 44th governor, I’ve lived my life by the Golden Rule,
working to build unity rather than fueling division.

Fortunately, Floridians are waking up to Ron DeSantis’s horrible agenda.
Multiple polls have shown me either neck and neck with him or outright
beating him, so I know this fight is winnable. DeSantis only won by 0.4%
in 2018. A recent Axios article said “Florida swing voters view Ron
DeSantis as too extreme.”

Beating DeSantis won’t be easy, but nothing worth doing ever is.

Peter,

This is the country's closest and most competitive battle. In 2020, Democrats won the Senate majority because of runoff wins in Georgia, and we can't let that happen again. **The future of our nation will be decided by what happens in Georgia on November 8.**

In a moment, I am going to ask every American patriot - _no matter where you live_ - **[to get off the sidelines and support my conservative friend Herschel Walker.](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61226551:6hMl0vVKN:m:1:3346849603:E47AEEAF12BE88BAF0DE806A46E140EA:r)** But first, you need to know why your help is so critical, Peter.
* Herschel's opponent, Senator Raphael Warnock, is the #1 fundraiser AND spender in the country when it comes to campaign dollars, **raising $64 MILLION this cycle and showing no signs of slowing down.**

* This race has been declared a "toss up," so it could go EITHER WAY. **[It's up to us to help Herschel move the needle even further to flip this seat back into Republican hands.](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61226551:6hMl0vVKN:m:1:3346849603:E47AEEAF12BE88BAF0DE806A46E140EA:r)**

This race will be over in less than 70 days. We won't get this time back, Peter, and we need to do everything possible to ensure we reclaim the Senate majority and get America back on track.

**[I'm asking you to step up with $25 or more to help Herschel WIN this seat and FLIP the Senate RED.](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61226551:6hMl0vVKN:m:1:3346849603:E47AEEAF12BE88BAF0DE806A46E140EA:r)**

**Can I count on you?**

Thank you,

Nikki Haley

P.S. We only need to flip one seat to end the Democrats' razor-thin majority. Herschel Walker will be our 51st Republican senator, but it will only happen if conservatives across the nation get off the sidelines and join his fight today. **[I'm ALL-IN for Herschel. ##
9 September 22

There are 2 weeks until mail-in ballots are sent out (Sep 24) and 6 weeks until early voting begins (Oct 27-Nov 3). We have a lot of work to do! We need your help to get America back on course.

For the first time in 35 years we have an opportunity to make a REAL difference in District 4. Please seize THIS moment!
**Final Donations**
The election is coming up soon! Please consider making a generous contribution. The maximum contribution is $2900 per person. Your donation will help us secure our commitments for print ads, radio ads and texting which all need to be purchased in advance. Your donation by September 15, will help us secure our media commitments.
Consider, $100, buys:
* 1 Radio Ad
* 5 Large Signs
* 20,000 texts

How many can you help us purchase?
**Sign Waving**
This Saturday, September 10
Noon-1p
The intersection of Rt 1 & Cherry Hill Road
Park at Starbucks
4750 Cherry Hill Rd, College Park, 20740
FREE JW4C T-shirt provided for those who have not yet received one.
Be sure to bring your water bottle.

**Yard Signs**
We want to begin having yard signs pop-up throughout the District especially for those who live on or near busy roadways.
Yard Signs are FREE, yet we are requesting a minimum $10 donation, if you're in a position to donate.

We are asking you for your donations, for your service, and your prayers. Together, we can do this! This is the power of teamwork! And the Best Is Yet To Come! Please reach out to us at info@JeffWarnerForCongress.com

In 8 weeks, the General Election counting will be in process. Let's Get This Done! Together!

[**Donate Here**](https://gmail.us6.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e2b757c427e67a891eab3e1b8&id=dd57fd6671&e=12a37459a2)

Remember, Jeff Warner is standing with you and for you. Enough is Enough! Together, "We The People" can make a real difference. Now is our time to act. THERE IS HOPE!

Standing with you,

Jeff

Yesterday, the Supreme Court of Michigan declared that abortion rights will be on their ballot in November. If Michigan voters support the measure, reproductive freedoms will be protected in that state — at least, so long as we make sure the GOP doesn't win the majority in Congress and try to pass a nationwide ban.
Just weeks ago, we saw voters in Kansas surprise the pundits when they voted NO on a proposed abortion ban in their very Red state. A strong outreach and information campaign led by countless organizers and volunteers was critical to that outcome and ensured citizens were aware of the stakes and of the deliberate campaign to confuse them about what a YES or NO vote meant.
The Bottom line: 14 states have already passed statewide abortion bans, and conservative legislatures in other states across the country are seeking to follow their lead. But Kansas shows that if we are organized and determined we can effectively fight back at the ballot box.
[**More than anything else, our actions in just under two months will determine whether we will be able to protect reproductive rights through national legislation in 2023 or whether extremists who want to tear them away will control the agenda. If Republicans take control of Congress a nationwide abortion ban will be at the top of their agenda. We can't let that happen.
The overwhelming majority of Americans are with us on this. And if folks turn out to vote in large numbers we can gain seats in the Senate and hold our majority in the House. But it is bound to be a very close election and we must make sure all voters know just how important their participation is.
[**So I'm asking — will you sign our pledge today and commit to getting out the word about what’s at stake this November? We can't and won't back down from the fight for reproductive freedoms.**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/50478627/366009019/-1229960928?refcode=em220909rrpetition&refcode2=3e470b2d-7730-ed11-ae83-281878b83d8a&contactdata=4GapuAFeJzZFn8G51ZkZpiGAFvsXKnPUF%2FtYdM%2F1OXOGOGOjt42GCHZeollRxZQX&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjEvMS84ODIzMiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIzZTQ3MGIyZC03NzMwLWVkMTEtYWU4My0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=H2wnDC3Dv-l9Zxu-GeOWYHoFTg3DdPfgEJRtkak505A=&emci=2f0637e9-7030-ed11-ae83-281878b83d8a&emdi=3e470b2d-7730-ed11-ae83-281878b83d8a&ceid=2216363)

## Derrick Gates for Congress Appreciation Cookout
---
|
---
Friends and Partners,We have been a little quiet the last couple of months as we pressed into the vision for the next season of our lives. It has certainly been a unique experience to give everything that you have and to come up short.
Some may see this as a loss, but we still see it as a victory. We originally ran against 15 competitors in my very first political race. We were elbowed out by an establishment candidate, but not before we showed the Nation that a grassroots candidate with zero political backing, experience, know-how, and finances could stir up the waters in a blue state.
We started with a few people showing up to meetings and within months we had thousands showing up to events. We ended up with close to every endorsement you could get outside of the GOP, but in the end politics is politics and cash is still King.
If we would have raised another 50K I think we would have taken the primary.
Moving forward!
Saturday October 1st our team will be hosting a beautiful backyard cookout in Rancho Palos Verdes to celebrate our victory and our gratitude for your support and love along the way.
Come hang out with influential people in this moment in time. Mover and shakers, those that hold office, people running now and in the future.
You will hear from some amazing folks and I will briefly share our pathway forward. Most of all, hang out and make relationships with people that will be helping to save our Nation.
Please RSVP officialderrickgates@gmail.com

We cannot afford to pay the record-high bills he's racking up. _Whether it's expensive student loan plans or countless billions sent over to Ukraine with ZERO accountability, it's TOO much. _
It's time to stand up to this out-of-touch, out-of-control regime and SAVE AMERICA _.___[**Are you with me?**](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61236279:6qixgvVNB:m:1:3253819041:2E03804F0FE001D55921A75ECE8D0D78:r)__

body:
To view this email as a web page, go to the link below, or copy and paste it into your browser's address window.
https://view.email.rondesantis.com/?qs=3a3c8ea853e655710314048ce8608b7a809c9c2a662cf2be406f385b03b926c5e5915ffbac2bbb080671877637ac9975ea0c0ea464c91afea95ad439c48b987c1f918cddcbf7134b17d3f81bbf9631ed

https://click.email.rondesantis.com/?qs=5ef38ba4dce3060d46b7643606f394d0389db6b8975247c2def970a3d32e005b192353bb28228cd09c50069857f5c5cc434918d63bdab076

Peter,

I’ve been hearing a lot of chirping coming from California about Florida.

For a state government that can’t even keep their lights on, they sure have a lot to say about a state that does things right.

The same California government that begged Floridians to move to their state to enjoy their “freedom” actually issued mandates for citizens to turn off their A/C, refrain from using appliances, and turn off their lights after 4:00 pm.

Is that the “freedom” they were referring to?

They also asked owners of electric vehicles not charge their cars during this time because their state power grid couldn’t handle it. This comes just a week after the announcement that California is banning the sale of gas-powered cars.

The state that forces you to buy an electric vehicle turned around and immediately banned the use of charging stations because their state infrastructure is not equipped to handle it.

It was only a matter of time before the same blue states who wanted to lock you down from COVID would start finding a new public emergency to tighten their control.
-
Dictating your means of transportation
-
Limiting your ability to use your transportation
-
Controlling when and what appliances and energy you use in your own home
That sounds more like a third-world dictatorship than a state within the most developed country in the world.

But that’s the Democrat game plan. Take away your self-sufficiency, take away your safety, and take your individual liberties until you are so completely reliant on the government, they now have complete control over your lives.
https://click.email.rondesantis.com/?qs=5ef38ba4dce3060d46b7643606f394d0389db6b8975247c2def970a3d32e005b192353bb28228cd09c50069857f5c5cc434918d63bdab076
>>>">Keep Democrat policy out of Florida! >>>

THAT is what we are up against this November.

Far-Left extremism is so out of control they are willing to destroy our country and your livelihoods to wield as much power for themselves as they can muster.

Democrat Eric Swalwell represents California's 14th Congressional District.
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ESCA-14-Email-Sept2022-FR-September?refcode=E17393-20220901-headerfooter-header-Other-RegTemplate-NA-NA&amount=25 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ESCA-14-Email-Sept2022-FR-September?refcode=E17393-20220901-headerfooter-header-Other-RegTemplate-NA-NA&amount=25]
Friends,

After President Biden’s partial student debt cancellation announcement, I was featured in the Los Angeles Times to share my first-hand experience with the growing student loan crisis facing Americans today and what a more equitable solution can look like.

https://www.latimes.com/politics/story/2022-08-29/swalwell-student-loans-zero-interest-bill [https://www.latimes.com/politics/story/2022-08-29/swalwell-student-loans-zero-interest-bill]

READ THE ARTICLE [https://www.latimes.com/politics/story/2022-08-29/swalwell-student-loans-zero-interest-bill]

Student loans have been a part of my life for decades – and still are. I was the first in my family to attend college, much less graduate from law school. And in order to pursue my dreams, my only option was to take out loans.

It was an investment in my future, and I knew what I was in for.

Now, our nation is trying to grapple with a trillion dollar debt problem, even with the up to $20,000 relief Biden has given to borrowers who make under $125,000 a year.

The Executive Order was a great first step, but Congress must also act on college affordability and debt for the long-term, like increasing Pell Grants, reforming our college accountability system, and eliminating the government’s ability to make money off federal student loans.

We can do this now before the COVID-19 forbearance ends in December. When payments resume, student loan borrowers shouldn’t have to worry about interest rates stacking up before making a dent in their loan totals. My bill, the No Student Loan Interest Act, can clear the path for student borrowers to pay off their balances.

You can learn more about the No Student Loan Interest Act and our nation’s student loan debt challenges by reading the Los Angeles Times here. [https://www.latimes.com/politics/story/2022-08-29/swalwell-student-loans-zero-interest-bill]

– Eric

| September 9, 2022

Dear Friend,

While scientists suspect climate change played a role in triggering the bloom, what fueled it is not a mystery. Algae blooms need food to grow, and this one had plenty: nutrients originating in wastewater that the region’s 37 sewage plants pump into the bay.

A major challenge is that most of the treatment plants date to the 1970s and ’80s, after the passage of the 1972 Clean Water Act and other regulations. Previously, municipalities simply pumped raw sewage into the bay.

I have been speaking about this for along time and my background in building WWTPs I can share there is great technology out there and we need to be investing in our infrastructure before literally wasting public funding on pet projects with little to no public benefit. Politicians need to Stop pandering to special interests groups on the back of the taxpayers for crony projects and start taking care of the major issues the government is actually expected to do!

Sincerely,

Michael Maher

| | | “Republican senators challenge immigration rule change on terrorist support”
---
[**READ MORE >>**](http://ci.criticalimpact.com/go/1/c8e2774da8d4d6d3c3d6b838967d376c/33013/fea96989acce4916/7660870eb0a42845c3d6b838967d376c/33013)
---
Peter,

To say I’m alarmed is an understatement... the Departments of Homeland Security and State have changed the immigration rules for those who have provided _“limited”_ material support to terrorist organizations. This is why I have joined nine of my Republican Senate colleagues in writing a letter to the Biden Administration’s DHS Secretary Mayorkas and Secretary of State Blinken. The cause for concern is serious and we are demanding full transparency. [You can read more about this story here >>>](http://ci.criticalimpact.com/go/1/c8e2774da8d4d6d3c3d6b838967d376c/33013/fea96989acce4916/8c0053cbc0281018c3d6b838967d376c/33013) American people deserve an explanation regarding the broad, open-ended nature of this authority for exempting individuals who would otherwise be barred from immigration to the United States for supporting a terrorist organization. Where is the Biden Administration coming up with its definitions? As it currently stands, this means current or former members of Iran’s Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC) or IRGC-linked entities would be admitted legal entry into our homeland at our southern border. This is not in America’s best interest. I will continue to push for answer, Peter. I promise you that. – Coach Tuberville

subject: Social Security

body:
[1]Charles Booker

Peter, Rand cannot
be trusted.

Rand Paul has been colluding with Rick Scott to take a chainsaw to Social
Security – a lifeline for millions of seniors and folks with disabilities.
As usual, Rand is abusing his power and punching down.

If Rand Paul finds a way to undermine Social Security, he will use it
every time – at the expense of millions of us across Kentucky and the
country.

If you care about protecting Social Security and expanding Medicare for
All, understand it is imperative we defeat Rand Paul this November. Rand
is one of the single most outspoken critics of Social Security in the
Senate and seeks to slash it at every turn.

Rand proposed budget cuts that would hurt seniors and families, even
cutting Social Security and Medicare for *current retirees.* This is not
the American Dream. This is not the American Promise. This is not Freedom.
We must do better, for our communities.

[ https://act.charlesbooker.org/go/18293?c0=20220909.EWhFFp&refcode=em20220909-2458&t=1001&akid=2458%2E346206%2EVmY-ox ]If you’re with me, I hope you can chip in $5 or anything
you can right now to support our grassroots-funded movement.

[ https://act.charlesbooker.org/go/18293?c0=20220909.EWhFFp&refcode=em20220909-2458&t=1020&akid=2458%2E346206%2EVmY-ox ]Contribute $5 →

For generations, Kentuckians have been waiting on change that doesn’t
come.

To this day, too many families can’t pay for groceries.

Too many of us can’t afford basic medication like insulin or inhalers.

Too many of us know what it means to go hungry and the fear of being one
emergency away from losing everything.

Social Security and Medicare are fundamental protections we rightfully
deserve. It is nothing but sheer cruelty to try to steal them from
millions of Americans.

Let’s be clear: Rand’s cruelty is a choice. This November, we can choose
something else. That’s why I’m running to replace Rand Paul – to be a
champion for working people across Kentucky and our nation.

[ https://act.charlesbooker.org/go/18293?c0=20220909.EWhFFp&refcode=em20220909-2458&t=1021&akid=2458%2E346206%2EVmY-ox ]Please chip in $5 or whatever you can today to our
campaign, and help me replace Rand Paul in the Senate so we can end
poverty and protect Social Security for good.

To a better future,

Charles

#### Announcement
**>From the Desk of Haneefah Khaaliq** Dear Hoosiers, a few months ago, I told you I was preparing a very special message for you that would be released soon in the form of an exclusive interview and short documentary. The [exclusive interview](https://haneefahkhaaliq.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b985b4d189b8b7b204cdd6958&id=7a283dea82&e=a49cb82bb3) was already released. I'm now happy to share with you the [short documentary](https://haneefahkhaaliq.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b985b4d189b8b7b204cdd6958&id=2f6299a4aa&e=a49cb82bb3).

After being swiftly removed from the primaries by the Indiana Election Commission, I suspected foul play and conducted a five-month investigation. As a result of unconscionable findings, I petitioned the Indiana Supreme Court and announced my decision to continue in this year's senate race as a write-in candidate.

It's important for you to understand that I would've had no problem bowing out of this election cycle, but not under these conditions. In this [documentary](https://haneefahkhaaliq.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b985b4d189b8b7b204cdd6958&id=6a6f166ef0&e=a49cb82bb3), I reveal to you the findings of my investigation and also my next political moves. If the cost of seeking justice means losing support then that's a price I'm willing to pay.
**Now, here's what I need you to do right now: **
* Share this message with nine (9) of your friends and family. Choose three (3) of them to personally call and inform!
* Commit to my campaign now by [donating $9](https://haneefahkhaaliq.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b985b4d189b8b7b204cdd6958&id=af8e353d4c&e=a49cb82bb3) or more to keep this true grassroots campaign going.
* [Subscribe and follow me on social media](https://haneefahkhaaliq.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b985b4d189b8b7b204cdd6958&id=ee9bb25dba&e=a49cb82bb3) where I'm active and live often. Share a post or two!

Visit [haneefahkhaaliq.org](https://haneefahkhaaliq.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b985b4d189b8b7b204cdd6958&id=393de65659&e=a49cb82bb3), view my 33 national policies and agendas, and become a volunteer today! I am Indiana. You are Indiana. Together, we are Indiana!

Sincerely,
Haneefah Khaaliq, Esq.
Indiana Candidate for U.S. Senate

| | | __**[You may not know me, so let me share my story.](http://links.bestamericanow.com/u/click?_t=f6e78b69acbb4291bd75bc93fae35a62&_m=de121849b3994642a5454f9d08831212&_e=dcvAjwz68DzS6RLFy0Iggf8e0Sjfdqm5rSPs_B5NS-MB_nLX-v22ym4h7ttI_sKEnzHp1DiSR-S9-Hc2l57m5qBhIt6mopCz3QjOcp_HZlIu--qJDF5GYv0akeh2PXxaMy5Bg9Cp98fPKh_LYeDe2epIl27WtrSDrxx8nbH8k9ROtSlQhTdaqZg_JnkyUlYpdDSdrGM_G3ztl0oLI1K65SMMRW-r56LdnS__R538UqOWUfP7B19xDY9hE6dYNdikRraAbrYILKn2gAa8fWIt24nobjrmpd2JBIswA3VRvgnAPYI9av6259g_IXU3etl6f_A5IMlulXrCVOHxRUbsV0DPCrLs1cf3x0U34RG36dJxs5oqdu7N_KwABJCtNWKv0OFBG6XSBI464kobWdKqpA%3D%3D "You may not know me, so let me share my story.")**__
My name's Tiffany Smiley. I'm a mom of three, veteran's wife, and Republican candidate for U.S. Senate in Washington.

I'm running against a 30-year Democrat incumbent to bring **real change** to our country.

I married my high school sweetheart, Scotty, who was permanently blinded by a suicide bomber while serving in Iraq.

From there, I took on the federal government to fight for the rights that Scotty _**earned**_ as an active duty service member, and I _**won**_.

Fighting for Scotty inspired me to **advocate for _all_ veterans**, so I went to D.C. to speak up for those who put their lives on the line for our country.

Now, I need _your_ help to send me to D.C. to advocate for Washingtonians and all Americans who have been hurt by the terrible policies of Joe Biden and my Democrat opponent Patty Murray.

Murray has been in office for _**three decades**_ and has done **nothing** to stop the rising crime, homelessness, and drug addiction crisis tearing my beloved home state apart.

I'm running for U.S. Senate because Americans deserve better than the failed leadership they've been stuck with for _years_.

It's time for a _**change**_ in D.C., and I'm the right person for the job.

The latest polls in Washington show that my opponent and I will be _**neck and neck**_ , and I'm getting nervous. We're _finally_ closing in on Murray, but I need your support to cross the finish line.

---
Hey folks – Did you see Elizabeth Warren’s message?

Republicans are laser-focused on flipping this seat. But Elizabeth Warren is standing with me to make sure they can’t and that Democrats have every advantage possible in our fight to keep the U.S. Senate in November.

**[Can you join me and Elizabeth Warren by chipping in $3 if you haven’t?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/50484839/366029857/-947982778?amounts=3,10,25,50,100&refcode=jtk1586-fr-in&recurring=0&amount=3&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODg1OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIzMDcxNmU4Zi04NjMwLWVkMTEtYWU4My0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=mwL1xpf4MWK8gH9DL4qWK1bk6dKB3Y7sHyPI32RW2T4=) **Read more about why she is supporting me and why your contribution is so important below.
\------- Forwarded message -------
From: **Elizabeth Warren**
Subject: My friend Maggie
| | |
---
Hi there, it’s Elizabeth Warren.
I want to talk about why I’m paying very close attention to what happens in New Hampshire this fall.
Right now, we’re just a couple of Senate votes short of ending the filibuster and passing federal protections for abortion rights — so if we expand our majority and hold onto the House, we can secure abortion rights nationwide as soon as January.
But that won’t be possible if we lose control of the Senate. That means we must defend every single Democratic incumbent up for reelection this year — including Maggie Hassan. The GOP has made her a top target, and right now, she needs our help to hold onto this seat.
**[That’s why I’m asking you if you can chip in to support her reelection campaign. Whatever you can give — $3 or $13 or more — will make a difference in keeping Maggie in the Senate.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/50484840/366029858/-947982778?amounts=3,10,25,50,100&refcode=jtk1586-fr-in&recurring=0&amount=3&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODg1OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIzMDcxNmU4Zi04NjMwLWVkMTEtYWU4My0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=mwL1xpf4MWK8gH9DL4qWK1bk6dKB3Y7sHyPI32RW2T4=)**
I’ve been proud to work shoulder to shoulder with Maggie to make progress on the priorities that matter most to American families. But our ability to protect the progress we have made and push for further action will come to a complete halt if Mitch McConnell flips just one seat and takes back the gavel in November.
McConnell’s vision for a Senate majority under his control is clear: radical, anti-choice, and obstructionist. We can’t let him make that vision a reality. We need Maggie’s voice and her vote in the Senate.
And she will need help from all of us. Because she won her last race by just 1,017 votes, the GOP is targeting her, and Maggie is in jeopardy of being replaced by a rubber stamp for Mitch McConnell’s radical right-wing agenda. We can’t let that happen.
**[So I have to ask again: If it makes sense for you right now, can you make a donation to help support my friend Maggie?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/50484841/366029859/-947982778?amounts=3,10,25,50,100&refcode=jtk1586-fr-in&recurring=0&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODg1OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIzMDcxNmU4Zi04NjMwLWVkMTEtYWU4My0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=mwL1xpf4MWK8gH9DL4qWK1bk6dKB3Y7sHyPI32RW2T4=)**
If we fight side by side, we can win. And we have to — this seat, and with it, our Senate majority, is on the line.
Thanks for being a part of this,

I want to talk about why I’m paying very close attention to what happens in New Hampshire this fall. Right now, we’re just a couple of Senate votes short of ending the filibuster and passing federal protections for abortion rights — so if we expand our majority and hold onto the House, we can secure abortion rights nationwide as soon as January. But that won’t be possible if we lose control of the Senate. That means we must defend every single Democratic incumbent up for reelection this year — including Maggie Hassan. The GOP has made her a top target, and right now, she needs our help to hold onto this seat. = I’ve been proud to work shoulder to shoulder with Maggie to make progress on the priorities that matter most to American families. But our ability to protect the progress we have made and push for further action will come to a complete halt if Mitch McConnell flips just one seat and takes back the gavel in November. McConnell’s vision for a Senate majority under his control is clear: radical, anti-choice, and obstructionist. We can’t let him make that vision a reality. We need Maggie’s voice and her vote in the Senate. And she will need help from all of us. clean_body: | | | Friend, I’ve emailed you a lot about Herschel Walker and Brian Kemp. I’m not doing this to bombard you with messages. I’m doing this to underscore the importance of their elections. The Left is outraising them at every turn and polling has these races too close to call. All eyes are on Georgia, friend. Republicans and Democrats alike are keeping a close watch on the spending, the polls, and the ground game of every major candidate. They’re looking to see if Georgia will flip back to Republican hands in the Senate or if Republicans will forfeit the state to the Democrats once again. We can’t let 2020 repeat itself when liberal Raphael Warnock defeated the Republican and handed Democrats control of the Senate. And we certainly cannot let them take control of the governor’s seat. When Stacey Abrams and Raphael Warnock launch attacks against Republicans with their multi-million dollar war chests, That’s why I'm in Georgia today, and it’s why I’m calling on you to step up. If Republicans band together and help Gov. Kemp and Herschel Walker compete with the Left’s massive fundraising numbers, we can get them one step closer to the finish line. But I need you. Can I count on you to step up before I leave for my next stop, friend? | Fellow activist, we have a breaking story for you today: [](https://click.everyaction.com/k/50485033/366030735/-632654605?refcode=EM_FR_220909J6Prayer_N_TEAM_90DO_4_G_N_G1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9BVi9BVjAwMS8xLzkwOTIwIiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImFmZjUzYjM5LTg4MzAtZWQxMS1hZTgzLTI4MTg3OGI4M2Q4YSIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=ZdTtf2RPNxezGXsqE0AIL82kygVRq_r-KaEm_i-r_W8=) Just one week before the January 6th insurrection, on a virtual meeting with Christian nationalists who hoped to keep Donald Trump in the White House, Doug Mastriano, **the GOP candidate for Governor of Pennsylvania** , “prayed Congress would ‘disregard’ Pennsylvania's election results,” and **disenfranchise the nearly 7 million voters who cast their ballots in the Commonwealth alone.**

But he wasn’t just addressing Congress. **“ _Looking ahead to Jan 6, [Mastriano] said: ‘I pray that... we’ll seize the power._ ’” Those aren’t the words of someone planning a peaceful trip to the Capitol.**

As described by _Rolling Stone_ , “Mastriano’s appearance is brief, but he delivers a rapid-fire prayer, dense with violent imagery,” such as his thinly veiled call to violence, praying “‘that we will seize our Esther and Gideon moments...’ invoking a pair of Old Testament heroes who made themselves instruments of God’s vengeance.” **[Fellow activist, this is yet more clear evidence that the threat to our democracy is ongoing, and it is dire. Governor Ron DeSantis said it best:

_**Joe Biden is the American Nero.**_

He is a failed leader and his smear campaign against half of the country is nothing more than division.

He dodders, he lashes out, he labels anyone who dares to dissent from the Regime a fascist – but at the end of the day, his policies are why Americans reject him.

**Biden has:**
* Caused record setting inflation
* Flung open the southern border letting in dangerous drugs
* Embraced the reckless defund the police agenda

I’ve never liked losing, and I don’t intend to start now. | Peter, We're less than 9 weeks away from Election Day, and every major political forecaster is calling the Georgia Senate race a "Toss-Up." Earlier this week, Politico issued updated rankings of the top Senate races in the nation and concluded much the same that FiveThirtyEight , Crystal Ball, and Cook Political Reports have before them: Georgia is anyone's race. Democrats have now spent more than $37 million on misleading attack ads against me, my family, and my business - yet polls remain a dead heat. A victory in Georgia is going to have widespread implications for every single American - not just those of us who live in the Peach State. So, if you want Kamala Harris to have the tie-breaking vote in the Senate for another two years, then pay no attention to this race. But if you're tired of the political gamesmanship in DC and our country going in the wrong direction, We're on a collision course with Senator Raphael Warnock, and there can only be one winner. Peter, I've never liked losing, and I don't intend to start now. Please help us move the needle - With this race consistently rated a TOSS-UP, we've got to make sure we leave no stone left unturned and no vote left unaccounted for. Dear Fellow American,

I am emailing you today because I want to simply thank you from the bottom of my heart for all your support, encouragement, prayers, and contributions during this election. Despite the results, my family and I could not be more proud, grateful, and honored for the opportunity to shed light on the great possibilities that America has to offer.

Our team and I poured our hearts, souls, and everything we had into this race, and I know there is no way we could have done it without you. So many of you sacrificed your time and resources. I will forever be grateful and never forgetful.

Thank you for the tens of thousands of doors you knocked or calls you made. Thank you for showing up to our events to cheer us on and encourage other voters to support our campaign. Thank you for letting me into your homes, including me in your prayers, and for giving me the support and encouragement to get us through the toughest days.

My family and I believe in the future of our district, our state, and our country. In fact, we believe so deeply in this country; too much to not continue fighting for it. I have faced challenges throughout my life and every time I got knocked down, I’ve stood right back up and fought harder. This time is no different. I will never give up on America!

I will always fight for the values and principles that this great country was founded upon, the values and principles my parents instilled in me from a very young age, and the values and principles I swore to defend and protect while serving in the U.S. Navy. I am a product of the American Dream, and I will always be indebted to this country, which allowed my parents an upward mobility: from immigrating on a working visa to pick fruits and vegetables and living out of their used car, to becoming business owners and community leaders, and raising four children who have gone on to become lawyers, doctors, or engineers. Only in America.

The best is yet to come for our nation if we continue to pray and fight for the restoration of our American values, morals, God, and love of country. The conservative principles of hard work, personal accountability, fiscal responsibility, and faith have proven to be the remedy, time and again, to many of our problems. Despite the disheartening and trying times that we are facing, I ask that you never give up on this country. Never lose hope or faith. Otherwise, the beginning of the end of this great nation will truly be in order. Stay the course with me, as I continue to fight for America and all Americans. So, on behalf of the next generation: “damn the torpedoes, full speed ahead!”

P.S. I am thankful to be able to call you a friend and I’m looking forward to keeping you on our team as we decide what the future holds.

Sincerely,

Rod

| _**ABOUT ROD**_

Rod Dorilás is the first-generation son of two immigrants from Haiti. His father immigrated to Florida to pick crops, and eventually his parents went on to own a small business. From a young age, his parents instilled in him the importance of hard work, integrity, and service.

At age 17, Rod enlisted in the United States Navy, serving for six years as a Petty Officer Second Class and Assistant Engagement Control Officer onboard the USS The Sullivans, stationed in Jacksonville. There, he was responsible for planning and executing the deployment of Tomahawk Land Attack Missiles on the Ballistic Missile Defense destroyer.

Upon completion of his military service, Rod attended law school at Syracuse University with the help of the G.I. Bill. After graduating, he served in President Trump's Administration in the U.S. Department of Commerce. While serving our great nation, Rod fought tirelessly to ensure that American families and businesses weren't taken advantage of by China.

Rod is a true public servant and is dedicated to serving his country and community. He wants to ensure that every American, through hard work and perseverance, can achieve the American Dream. Rod is running for Congress in South Florida to continue Trump's America First Agenda and defend our country from the Radical Left.

---

| Paid for by Rod Dorilas for Congress
---

body:
You don’t go from public defender to the first African American woman to serve as Chief Justice of North Carolina without leading boldly.
#
Team - It’s Travis, Cheri’s campaign manager.
I made a tough decision in our budget meeting this morning, and I wanted to let you know myself.
This week, as you may know, McConnell’s super PAC went on the air with an attack ad against Cheri. The first ad in a nearly $30 million buy. Their spending could go up, and the viciousness of the attacks will almost certainly get worse.
So after talking it through with Cheri and our team, we agreed that we needed to up our spending on some of our advertising and organizing efforts sooner than we’d planned. Even though the money wasn’t in the budget, I gave the green light.
Look, we cannot delay setting the record straight and let Republican super PACs control the narrative. We need to make sure voters know the truth now.
This unexpected spending increase created a hole in our budget. But Cheri said we should make the bet that if we reached out and told you the truth about why this was so important that our grassroots supporters would come through to keep us on the path to victory.
What do you say? Sound worth it to flip this seat?

name: Trudy Busch Valentine
subject: the cost of Eric Schmitt's vote
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Trudy Busch Valentine for Senate
body:
For just a few expensive dinners, Eric Schmitt has sold out Missouri families time and time again.
| | |
---
Peter, right now, families are spending a lot of time thinking about prices. Gas, groceries, keeping the lights on – the price of just about everything keeps on rising.
But my opponent, Eric Schmitt, doesn't care about rising prices. The only price on his mind is how much the next lobbyist will give him to vote their way – regardless of what it costs his constituents.
**You see, Eric Schmitt's vote has always been for sale.** He's taken more than $10,000 in gifts from lobbyists and campaign contributions from special interests – and they got what they paid for.
They bought his vote to protect Big Pharma profit margins. They bought his lawsuit to let health insurance companies charge Missouri women and seniors more for health care. And they bought his votes to sell Missouri farmland to a Chinese company. **For just a few expensive dinners, an exclusive golf trip, a couple tickets to the big game, or even a Christmas ham, Eric Schmitt has sold out Missouri families time and time again.**
**And now, he's running for Senate because he knows that he can charge even more for his vote in Washington.** For him, this is all about power and the money that comes with it. Missourians deserve better than that.
That's why I'm in this race. As a nurse and a children's advocate, I've spent my life serving my community. I'm running for Senate to continue that commitment to service and make life better for families back home – not make a buck at the expense of my home state. And I've released a plan to end the corruption and greed that's doing so much damage in Washington.
**You have my word on this: I will be no one's senator but yours – and my vote will _never_ be for sale. **
**But just like Eric Schmitt's vote, winning this race comes at a price.** I'll only defeat Schmitt and his far-right megadonors if grassroots supporters like you stand with my campaign.**[That's why I have to ask: Please, will you make a $5 donation to help me flip Missouri blue, defeat Eric Schmitt, and bring real integrity to Washington?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/50487757/366040382/-1746441832?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&amount=5&refcode=jtk277-fr-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzMvMS85NzQ4MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIyYzc5YmVjZi05MzMwLWVkMTEtYWU4My0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=64Rw_mb2Ghy2AcGx3i33GAkFFs18K8Vb67fbdh7aXmY=)**

Geoff and Leah

body:
Derek,

The last two polls show me tied against Tim Michels — Trump's handpicked
choice to replace me as governor.

[ https://go.tonyevers.com/go/1570?amount=10&refcode=TE_EM_FR_3MU_20220909_1_1&t=1001&akid=4603%2E1827488%2Efkym8U ][IMG]
Defeating me is Trump's top priority because Michels is willing to throw

Happy Friday Team,

With September kicking off at full speed this week, things are already heating up quickly. We’re exactly **60 days out** from the midterm elections, and it’s urgent that we regain some of the grassroots momentum that we inevitably lost over the summer months.

GOP candidates across the country are garnering major support by parroting Trump ideology and inciting far-right extremism, cushioned by financial support from millionaires and corporate super PACs.

If Democrats want a shot at winning key seats in November, we need to refresh our strategy **_because the status quo is simply not enough._** We can no longer rely on mainstay establishment politicians to run the same stale campaigns with mediocre results.

**The American people are burnt out.** We're tired of putting our faith into representatives who don't actually represent us. What we need right now is real working-class leaders who will inspire us and truly be our voice. We need bold changemakers who will give regular, everyday people hope and energize Democratic voters enough to get them to the polls.

But the current system is inherently designed to favor the elite and to perpetuate the socioeconomic barriers that keep working-class folks out of office. And so the toxic cycle of inaction and out-of-touch leadership continues.

**_That’s why Barrier to Entry exists — to level the playing field._** We equip working-class progressives who lack the pedigree or financial advantages with necessary resources so that regardless of their background, they can fight for us and demand better for the American people. | | Hello, Are you worried about what kids are learning in school today? I know I am.

That's why I wanted to do something about it by creating the Little Patriots Program.

The Little Patriots Program provides a curriculum for grades K-5 that teaches the REAL history of America.

We provide this curriculum **free of charge** for parents, grandparents, guardians, homeschoolers, and teachers.

We are also working with conservative Hollywood producers to create a tremendous cartoon series called "Star Spangled Adventures" that helps explain each lesson in a fun and entertaining way.

clean_body: | | Friend, As of today, there are just 60 days until the election. Soon, we will go to the ballot box and cast our ballot to determine what kind of leadership we want for the next two years. We’ve done so much together already. We’ve built an inspiring grassroots campaign made up of everyday Vermonters. ** I’ve enjoyed every bit of this being brought on to this campaign so far, and am incredibly proud of what we’ve all done together. Now, we’re entering the time when all eyes are on us for this election. Our momentum is growing, and we now only have two months to show the people of Vermont that we are the best choice to look out for their interests. I won’t let you down. For each day of the next two months, I will put everything I have into fighting for the people of Vermont. We’ll be out talking to you, and hearing what your communities need most. So many Vermonters are depending on us to access housing, heal the overdose crisis, take bold climate action, and be proactive on the erosion of our reproductive and civil liberties. We can’t and won’t let them down. We need your support to win this thing and continue our momentum. ** If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately: Thank you, Brenda Siegel | | | | | | Copyright (C) 2022 Brenda for Vermont. name: Team AOC
subject: Us, unionized? Duh 😏
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez for Congress
body:
We organized our workplace and you can too!
[](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=ocasio-campaign.krJqR8&refcode=em20220909-3377-P_ORG_EXP_LAB&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1&akid=3377%2E2526796%2EayTSve)
It’s been a great Labor Week, discussing some of our favorite labor wins in NY-14 and across the country. Before we wrap up, we wanted to share the story of how Team AOC unionized, and how you can too!
In 2020, it was announced that Alexandria’s campaign staff (that’s us!) reached a deal to unionize with the Campaign Workers Guild, ratifying a contract that included overtime pay above 40 hrs/week (unheard of for campaigns!), paid parental leave, childcare resources, unlimited sick leave, salary caps for managers, and protections for immigrant and transgender workers (plus more!).
_Alexandria put it best: “Workers’ rights are the cornerstone of an economy that puts humanity first. I’ve lived without health insurance or dignity in the workplace, and I applaud the work our team has done to raise the bar for all workers.”_
[](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/4255?t=2&akid=3377%2E2526796%2EayTSve)
Organizing a workplace can be daunting, but our bargaining committee kept at it, knowing their contract could inspire other campaigns and workers everywhere (yes, even you!) to fight for their own protections.
**And you don’t have to do it alone. We’ve put together a comprehensive[Guide to Workplace Organizing](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/4255?t=3&akid=3377%2E2526796%2EayTSve) so you’ll have all the tools you need to get started** — including printable exercises, spreadsheets, and conversation guidelines to start mapping your workplace relationships. Organizing is all about coming together to address issues common to you and your coworkers, and we want to make it easy for you to initiate that process.
We hope you’ve had a fruitful and inspiring Labor Week, and we wish you success and strength on the road to building union power!
In solidarity,
Team AOC

subject: Better jobs, stronger infrastructure, and a brighter future for Kentucky
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY ANDY BESHEAR FOR GOVERNOR
body:
But there’s still work to be done Peter —

Since I stepped into office, I’ve made it clear that my priority will always be Kentuckians. Through thick and thin, my administration focuses on improving the lives of everyone in our Commonwealth.

That means ensuring that our people can access quality health care, that our most vulnerable have a voice at the ballot box, and that Kentucky is a welcoming, inclusive place for everyone.

Under this administration, Kentucky's economy is on fire. Last year alone, my administration has brought in record investments with companies investing $11.2 billion in Kentucky and creating more than 18,100 full-time jobs. We've achieved the lowest-ever unemployment rate in our state’s history, back-to-back years of surplus revenue, and the largest rainy day fund on record.

These accomplishments are more than just numbers on the board. They translate into more funding for education and health care, improvements to our roads, bridges, and other vital infrastructure, and food on the table for so many hardworking Kentuckians.

I'm focused on fighting for economic opportunity for every family, one job at a time, but our work is far from over. I’m proud to be your governor, and I hope to have your support for another four years.

-Andy

Embarrassing doesn’t begin to describe Gov. DeSantis’s behavior. Trying to use Florida as a pawn in his political games — a _**disgrace**_ is more like it.

[1]Justice Democrats

Peter, did you
know that our organization was inspired by Bernie Sanders’ 2016 run for
President?

After the campaign ended, a few staffers decided to continue the work to
fight to elect progressives by launching Justice Democrats. For a team
with a small budget, we’ve had quite an impact in the last few years:

→ We recruited AOC, Cori Bush, and Jamaal Bowman to run and helped their
campaigns win in competitive primary elections against entrenched
incumbents.

→ This cycle we’ve helped Greg Casar and Summer Lee win their primary
elections and now they’re on their way to the General Election in
November.

We reject all corporate PAC contributions because we’re fighting everyday
to end corporate influence in Washington and elect progressive fighters
who are a part of the communities they’re representing.

The cold hard truth is that there’s no one waiting in the wings to do this
work if we don’t do it together. If people don’t give, our progressive
movement could be locked out of power for decades to come. So whether you
give some of your time, talents, and/or financial contributions, it really
makes a big difference.

Peter, our work is
year-round, candidate recruiting and campaign planning is a massive
undertaking — especially when we’re going up against entrenched incumbents
with millions of dollars in the bank.

Fellow American,

clean_body: What we do now will determine the priorities and power of the 118th Congress. | | | Peter, As primary season draws to a close, WFP candidates have held ground and made incredible progress in some of the most important races in the country. Consider Mandela Barnes’ primary victory in Wisconsin. If successful, Mandela will replace Senator Ron Johnson and become the 51st vote in the Senate to abolish the filibuster — paving the way for the passage of necessary legislation, including codifying abortion rights into law. And look at the eight new WFP champions who have already won hotly contested primaries in Congressional races this year, from Texas to Oregon to Pennsylvania, Illinois and more. Nationwide, Working Families Party members are fighting to elect working class champions to expand our majorities and represent all of us in Congress — and winning. But with every step forward, we draw even more attention from right-wing Super PACs, who are about to funnel even bigger swathes of cash from the ultra-wealthy as we approach November. With just two months until Election Day, we need to redouble our efforts to make sure all our champions are elected in November. What we do now makes a huge difference in November, in the priorities and power of the 118th Congress, and in the future of this country. And weekly contributions allow us to budget out how the next nine weeks will go — meaning we can focus less time on fundraising, and more time on organizing. Let’s make each of the next nine weeks count. In solidarity, Working Families Party Thoughts? Feedback? We want to hear it. Reply directly to this email and let us know. subject: Dr. Oz: “It’s still murder”
