body:
I have *always* supported the right to an abortion.
#
Derek,
Dr. Oz was caught lying about his extreme views on abortion... again.
Earlier this week Oz lied to supporters, saying he doesn’t support criminalizing abortion. But leaked audio from a previous event caught him saying that abortion at any stage of development is “murder.”
**We cannot let a liar like Dr. Oz anywhere near the U.S. Senate.** ESPECIALLY when Mitch McConnell + the Republicans want to ban abortion nationwide.
**[Derek, help me beat Dr. Oz + become the 51st Democratic vote to codify _Roe_ into law. Make a donation of any amount today so we can win this race, flip this seat, and protect the right to an abortion.](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20220909-2?refcode=em20220909-7188&refcode2=7188_434096_SMr7DP&akid=7188%2E434096%2ESMr7DP)**
**[Contribute Now](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20220909-2?amount=5&refcode=em20220909-7188&refcode2=7188_434096_SMr7DP&akid=7188%2E434096%2ESMr7DP)**
This dude is really out-of-touch, Derek.
During this campaign, Dr. Oz has:
> ❌ Called _Roe v. Wade_ “wrong”
> ❌ Said he supports a ban on abortions with no exceptions for rape or incest
> ❌ Called all forms of abortion, at any stage at any time, “murder”
We don’t have to guess what will happen if this dude buys his way into the U.S. Senate: **It’s clear he’d be a consistent vote against abortion rights and to appoint judges that take those rights away.**
My message to Dr. Oz and the Republicans is simple: **Don’t f*ck with a woman’s reproductive freedom.** It’s a non-negotiable right, and we won’t let these extreme attacks stand.
**[But I need you with me. Help me defeat Dr. Oz + his virtually unlimited ca$h by chipping in whatever you can, and send me to the Senate as Democrats’ 51st vote to codify _Roe_ into law.](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20220909-2?refcode=em20220909-7188&refcode2=7188_434096_SMr7DP&akid=7188%2E434096%2ESMr7DP)**
We won’t let Dr. Oz spend his way into the U.S. Senate, and we won’t let Republicans strip away the right to abortion.
Thanks for being in this fight,
John ❤️
John Fetterman
Lieutenant Governor of Pennsylvania
Democratic Nominee for U.S. Senate

**[Donate](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-emails?refcode=em20220909-7188-footer&t=1&refcode2=7188_434096_SMr7DP&akid=7188%2E434096%2ESMr7DP)**

subject: Last night, the choice was clear
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY WELCH FOR VERMONT
body:
Pitch in for the final stretch of our campaign

# [](https://act.welchforvermont.com/go/144?t=2&akid=911%2E61531%2EwvyUkS)
Hello,
Last night’s debate drew a clear line in the sand.
The choice in this election couldn’t be more clear: Do voters want to elect Peter to fight for abortion rights, progress on climate change, and lower costs for families? Or do they want to hand the Senate back to Mitch McConnell’s GOP and the rollback of our rights and freedoms?
Last night, our opponent shared the following views:
* He supports overturning _Roe vs. Wade_ , even in cases of rape and incest, and he wouldn’t take any action to protect abortion rights as senator.
* He supports INCREASED oil drilling on public lands.
* Said he was “encouraged” by the recent _West Virginia v. EPA_ decision, which put the interests of corporate polluters over clean air and water.

Five years after Hurricane Harvey devastated Houston, **we’re still recovering.** Harvey resulted in $125 billion in damage, and so much still remains. We must do better to help our residents fully recover, especially the most vulnerable among us.

I penned this op-ed with so many of the low-income seniors I have met along this Harvey recovery journey in mind and with a call to action to do the work to ensure they get the help they need. **_[Click here to read the full op-ed ➡️](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/dSCQfi9FLISmU3ZE3bfPhoMTWfH9-cmf8bvHdO-RTLpN8fu-sp0BvbGwbruARoFv1Tc2rsqaL4JRXlDsAQlMndQ7MuifV1jfqVnr8JCK3a3UkUEU8K6eHGgiF9p_m8KyNVHkRsNtpcjyV2lFqtfKBXkk9bFBGhU9wExIdzpvpZJ5d_pTyOOvdtbEPL0RIBbU4ouD5FSAMp1-slVk1YAbgdKc64wZDao9SLJdDNh7g1-A_rJkCtsdkHu7rshSO9cfpS3UFHhwZ47zYjopPEQcpFf9Q2-cmyde6QX80H4i9xmrwtX5sge_WVJDYnGwHq7ScVzdsW6EcYbhL7CaqFDjkbxv4RMrwlxaJxBIabsiMsNaxPKoYe-qVuFUg5HKv01ePg0zzpDmGXhFUUomvMR9saosJM-UV9giouXEtCu4dXZhWgt1Zqopb7ezy0aGXA71/3pb/c9jVI2b6Rd2yw8GSxN98Gw/h1/Ruv5CQIqX3VZ2y4JyJ_JUuMs23o-p503cAYoC0prjn8)_** [](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/dSCQfi9FLISmU3ZE3bfPhoMTWfH9-cmf8bvHdO-RTLpN8fu-sp0BvbGwbruARoFv1Tc2rsqaL4JRXlDsAQlMndQ7MuifV1jfqVnr8JCK3a3UkUEU8K6eHGgiF9p_m8KyNVHkRsNtpcjyV2lFqtfKBTg-CDm1DRDJUyAdk1PzVNowCmvIhaizfyZB_aAwlsSUe8E493q6FLo4SmjgAqOlVHZDbOv1FXbB_op8FWbg3h-I2QxVKgeUQirVzzoL__vgyOOzvrl0J_JFPdAr6ijjXN-Z-WGdUbJV4t8AHyRSyupQ50pYFrykmdM-BEYA5VI16aZSZDlow-2e7DFqRRVugy-ZdBJ-Om9d8oIOtpMM0d3oD4LVg-wnLqh0nw3durRQ4O94ovXbkMabbQmJmuUJvEy7ZzeDHb270Jb0YSRxMktvnNa9fstwaDKv1ftRzVZB/3pb/c9jVI2b6Rd2yw8GSxN98Gw/h2/fWQzRsS6-FXlrx3B3Ti1Y9DxVYn1JEkdc085O0qRVes) In the aftermath of Harvey, residents are still in need of financial support for home repairs. _Fewer than a couple thousand single-family homes have been fully repaired using federal funds._

**Many of our residents have given up on getting the help they need** and have found themselves lost in political battles between federal, state, and local governments or denied recovery funds through overly complex systems.

Seeing so many of our seniors with their health at risk from living in homes with flood-soiled walls catalyzed my work to mobilize hundreds of Houstonians to go door-to-door to canvas low-income senior communities and provide them with assistance in the years after the hurricane.

_Now, as Houston’s next mayor, I will prioritize helping those still in need._ I’ve spent years on the frontlines fighting to help our most vulnerable residents recover and get the help they need. As Houston’s next Mayor, I’ll ensure that our most vulnerable residents are not left behind on this long road to recovery.

clean_body: Five short years ago, our region was devastated by Harvey’s catastrophic damage. | | | | | Team, Five years after Hurricane Harvey devastated Houston, we’re still recovering. Harvey resulted in $125 billion in damage, and so much still remains. We must do better to help our residents fully recover, especially the most vulnerable among us. I penned this op-ed with so many of the low-income seniors I have met along this Harvey recovery journey in mind and with a call to action to do the work to ensure they get the help they need. In the aftermath of Harvey, residents are still in need of financial support for home repairs. Fewer than a couple thousand single-family homes have been fully repaired using federal funds. Many of our residents have given up on getting the help they need and have found themselves lost in political battles between federal, state, and local governments or denied recovery funds through overly complex systems. Seeing so many of our seniors with their health at risk from living in homes with flood-soiled walls catalyzed my work to mobilize hundreds of Houstonians to go door-to-door to canvas low-income senior communities and provide them with assistance in the years after the hurricane. Now, as Houston’s next mayor, I will prioritize helping those still in need. I’ve spent years on the frontlines fighting to help our most vulnerable residents recover and get the help they need. As Houston’s next Mayor, I’ll ensure that our most vulnerable residents are not left behind on this long road to recovery. | | **_You may not know me, so let me share my story._** My name’s Tiffany Smiley. I’m a mom of three, veteran’s wife, and Republican candidate for U.S. Senate in Washington. I’m running against a _30-year_ Democrat incumbent to bring **real change** to our country. I married my high school sweetheart, Scotty, who was permanently blinded by a suicide bomber while serving in Iraq. name: Pramila Jayapal
subject: Only 30% of Republicans…
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Pramila for Congress
body:
We have to be honest about what we’re facing in November.
#
Peter,
Here's the reality of the situation: GOP candidates are running on the Big Lie in races for influential seats across the country, _and they're winning_. 261 candidates on ballots across America deny that President Biden won the 2020 election. >
**Just 30% of Republican candidates agree the election was legitimate.** And even then, many of those candidates still raise the same age-old dogwhistles about election integrity and voter fraud.
Many of these election-deniers are all but guaranteed to win in November.
[](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/17147?refcode=em20220909-1602&t=1&akid=1602%2E420207%2Ez8fnpk)
With so little time to process the loss of our constitutional right to abortion under _Roe v. Wade_ , it can be hard to refocus on the future while we are still angry and grieving now. But if anything, the overturning of Roe shows us that **nothing is off the table.**
There was a time not so long ago when many Democrats believed Donald Trump could never win the Presidency in America – but he did. **We cannot let what we want to be true blind us to what is already happening.**
There is no playbook for this moment. But I do believe that we will persevere as long as we're willing to do the hard work required to protect our democracy.
[**Progressives will always be the first line of defense against right-wing extremists in America – that's why it's critical that our campaigns stay strong and we win our elections across the board this fall. Will you chip in to help?**](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/17147?refcode=em20220909-1602&t=2&akid=1602%2E420207%2Ez8fnpk)
We're navigating an unstable political landscape, and the Republicans know it – they're trying to seize this moment and regain control of major offices in the midterms.
**I will never stop fighting for truth, for accountability, and for our democracy – and neither will Democrats.** Our progressive caucus is united against these extremist fearmongers. That's why it's critical our members are re-elected and new visionary leaders will join us to fight for their communities.
There's a reason why I have dedicated so much time and energy to supporting powerful, popular progressives who will bring much-needed energy and new perspectives to Congress. **It is our job to give our communities something to believe in – to believe that we will not stand down, but fight back, and win.**
We must work harder, think smarter, and strategize for the long-term. [**I've spent days on the road with progressives all over the country and am proud to lead our progressive caucus in Congress. If you want to help us organize against the extreme GOP election deniers – chip in $3 or any amount today.**](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/17147?refcode=em20220909-1602&t=3&akid=1602%2E420207%2Ez8fnpk)
**[Contribute](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/17147?refcode=em20220909-1602&t=22&akid=1602%2E420207%2Ez8fnpk)**
In solidarity,
Pramila

**[Contribute](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/pj-email-footer?refcode=em20220909-1602-footer&t=23&refcode2=1602_420207_z8fnpk&akid=1602%2E420207%2Ez8fnpk)**

| | | Hi there,

We’re getting down to the wire folks. **Election day is 61 days out, and I’m hoping to earn your support if I haven’t already. **

**While Rep. Fitzgerald is nowhere to be found most days, I’ve been talking with residents in the district, and I know where we must start to do better.** We must invest in education, address the crisis of climate change, help both workers and small businesses thrive while taming inflation, and make sure our communities are safe. We must ensure our democracy works, that all of us are equal and treated fairly and with dignity, that we have access to quality, affordable healthcare, and that we meet the foreign and domestic challenges of today.

[Can you help me do better by bringing these common-sense values to Washington with a donation of $100, $50, $25 or even $10 today?](https://MikeVanSomeren.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a8d3e4f455e56b0d81700f39a&id=a5c48cad1c&e=356c0699dd)

| While Rep. Fitzgerald feels safe and secure to play his partisan games thanks to gerrymandering, I believe in voters' ability to choose the candidate who is going to fight for them this time around. The reality is that voters across the country, from New York to Kansas to Alaska have demonstrated they are open to voting against their party brand if it’s in their best interest. **This is great news for us and bad news for Rep. Fitzgerald — help us fight back.**

**Rep. Fitzgerald can’t even be bothered to show up and talk with his constituents, let alone serve us in Washington.** He’s letting the real, kitchen table issues affecting all of us here at home (like bodily autonomy and price gouging) go unaddressed while he pockets millions from big-money interest groups to further their own agenda, while families here at home suffer.

If it’s not in lockstep with his party and its bosses, Rep. Fitzgerald isn’t going to consider it. And if it’s not benefitting him politically, he’ll let it fall by the wayside, even if it means our rights and livelihoods continue to deteriorate. He’s not even here to listen to us while Congress is in recess!

_**We cannot reward this behavior — it’s time to replace him.**_ To truly compete with big money interest groups and millionaire donors who will do whatever they can to buy our elections and work against American families, [I need your support.](https://MikeVanSomeren.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a8d3e4f455e56b0d81700f39a&id=5c7b72f201&e=356c0699dd)

Anything you are able to give will help us secure the resources to fight back, win in November, and fix our broken system in Washington. I can’t do this without you on my team, and I’m so grateful for your support.

Thank you,

Mike

Yesterday, the DNC Resolution Committee refused to allow a vote on our resolution to Ban Dark Money from Democratic Primaries — a top priority of our members and the grassroots of the Party.

Now, the real work begins. Our Revolution Board members Larry Cohen and Jane Kleeb are helping lead a coalition of 33 progressive DNC members to get this resolution to the full floor — and we have powerful support from Bernie, Ro Khanna, Pramila Jayapal, and others behind us.

Let's be clear, if the Democratic Party's official position is to oppose the influence of dark money in politics, they should have no problem passing this resolution to ban dark money in primaries.

Dems can't be the Party of democracy in one breath and then allow an astronomical amount of money from Republican megadonors and corporate interests to flood Democratic primaries.

Despite the onslaught of dark money, progressives clinched critical wins in the 2022 primaries - folks like Greg Casar (TX-35), Summer Lee (PA-12), and many others are headed to Congress and building a progressive bench down-ballot.

But, we also saw sudden waves of cash drown districts with false smears against some of our most beloved candidates, leading to heartbreaking losses and erasing 30-point leads in the campaign's final weeks.

This is abhorrent and anti-democratic. It cannot stand, and Democrats have an opportunity to change it.

**_[Can you chip in ASAP so we can send as many calls as possible to DNC members showing them that Democratic voters want to pass this resolution and Ban Dark Money from the primaries?](https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/7577?refcode=OR_EM_FR_3MO_20220909_3_4&t=15&akid=3371%2E5885482%2EIZR7Fy)_**

In solidarity,

Our Revolution

Team,

This week, the news broke: Mike DeWine, who Donald Trump once called a “terrible, terrible guy” now has Trump’s endorsement – an endorsement in which he attacked me.

It’s no surprise, given what they have in common. Both of them are more interested in lining their own pockets and those of their wealthy supporters rather than fighting for the interests of the middle and working class. Both of them are right-wing extremists who will say or do anything to be elected. And both of them are out of step with the working families of Ohio.

Fellow Conservative,

More than ten years ago, I stepped off the bus and into Officer Basic Training to become a Marine.

During Officer Basic Training, I went through weapons and combat training, extensive military history classes, and drill – but beyond all the physical training, I was taught that **everything is earned, never given**.

After countless hours, too many pull-ups to count, and hard work – I was commissioned as an Officer, got my official pin, and earned my spot in the Marines. It wasn’t easy. _Things that are great rarely are._

Today, I’m training to serve my country in a different capacity. Instead of weapons and combat training, I’m knocking on doors, and talking to constituents. Rather than history lessons, I’m sending emails just like this one. I subbed out pull-ups for putting up campaign signs.

All this training is still for the same purpose: **to serve Americans and protect our great nation from threats both foreign and domestic.**

[**_Today, let me earn your support because I know it is too valuable to just be given freely._**](http://links.ourdefenseofamerica.com/u/click?_t=aa3ef0db03454a26b650c9ca7e919386&_m=3a50435b0dec449e833520153bc7a715&_e=K3xSFw8iPScKTwUmXFPZx0tA0cnNGSyYFzrZThwMv-dpfh0WL0iDvkXrQoM-oklJ6l7K_KzN9gnA1ZAtd_CJTKxKZs3OnC2cCxXHSi81HOOXb6DnTenZS9rArbvzbNs6io5N-j1Z9cFzoMZE5_yXlhegq7lg2rLRGkl3g55zS9IUMEpoy2dYF3aeKhDfMv9yKVO_taNW1s1K5AL3OeeC0ZixEKXfP6oujKlNaR-Brt1XIYIOwQL6siUqUMAjblZkT_4I6kMewroW_X7kM9QU2c0T77ooTsrgYj7YLS0nsgCXOzH7nL6nzWjL6dzXyph-x1RckF2X82GvLhB7feobS5o40vq3QRxQg_1TpCAj_ImfH0jQJuhwlA-yioFI3nvoozphcalebzLbpVI2vAC-Dw%3D%3D)

I’m fighting to bring the values I learned in the Marine Corps to Washington. _**Honor, courage, commitment.**_ Far too many folks in Washington are too busy playing partisan politics, instead of doing the work of the people. [**I’m on a mission to change that.**](http://links.ourdefenseofamerica.com/u/click?_t=aa3ef0db03454a26b650c9ca7e919386&_m=3a50435b0dec449e833520153bc7a715&_e=K3xSFw8iPScKTwUmXFPZx0tA0cnNGSyYFzrZThwMv-dpfh0WL0iDvkXrQoM-oklJ6l7K_KzN9gnA1ZAtd_CJTKxKZs3OnC2cCxXHSi81HOOXb6DnTenZS9rArbvzbNs6io5N-j1Z9cFzoMZE5_yXlhegq7lg2rLRGkl3g55zS9IUMEpoy2dYF3aeKhDfMv9yKVO_taNW1s1K5AL3OeeC0ZixEKXfP6oujKlNaR-Brt1XIYIOwQL6siUqUMAjblZk9Sd0g1RBxXR_cuzbKFOsxgkKhWjXLrrwYNvQuHR4fGnDaMUQ66KsAjDJbJVboPZ8hBFjePMeaYDl_b7sLIpD-LnVOWPAS5uke0_AQ-APe8qdVrCLYkC2lV8uR6hqr6eZE3hNsbwgb5NuUkfcMBg9NQ%3D%3D)

I know that saving our country from the radical Democrats goes far beyond what I can do on the frontlines of Washington, but I also know that winning this race is our best chance at taking our country back.

[**Just like I earned a spot to serve in the Marine Corps,_with your essential support_ , I hope to earn a spot in Congress, so I can continue to answer the call for service.**](http://links.ourdefenseofamerica.com/u/click?_t=aa3ef0db03454a26b650c9ca7e919386&_m=3a50435b0dec449e833520153bc7a715&_e=K3xSFw8iPScKTwUmXFPZx0tA0cnNGSyYFzrZThwMv-dpfh0WL0iDvkXrQoM-oklJ6l7K_KzN9gnA1ZAtd_CJTKxKZs3OnC2cCxXHSi81HOOXb6DnTenZS9rArbvzbNs6io5N-j1Z9cFzoMZE5_yXlhegq7lg2rLRGkl3g55zS9IUMEpoy2dYF3aeKhDfMv9yKVO_taNW1s1K5AL3OeeC0ZixEKXfP6oujKlNaR-Brt1XIYIOwQL6siUqUMAjblZklkWpFe_UIIgOGXeSj7tb266kAE1KL8piaN-waSEhvtto85rTW6jCYQTRuFKxHrZHzgJReXeuwEeJ5WstcY-ZuY1EGBnVodfuECFb2Dv9_b5dv4lHDZW-KjVXK7KDNgiFS-C2XvuKqetTlnHRYRlaVw%3D%3D)

---
| | Friend,**

** Joe Biden’s inflation is **hurting** everyone. And the truth is, **Laura Kelly keeps making daily life less affordable for Kansans! ** She calls herself the education governor. She’s really the inflation governor. In less than four years in office, Kelly has increased overall annual state spending by $6 billion, including $1.8 billion funded by general state taxes. If that wasn’t enough, she wants to raise taxes on all Kansans who earn more than $50,000 per year to pay for her liberal spending. Those are everyday hard-working Kansans that will continue to feel the**hurt** of the Biden-Kelly agenda. President Biden reiterated his promise to be the most pro-union president in American history. Thanks to his and Vice President Harris's leadership, we're going to build a future in America, with American workers, in American factories, using American-made products.

Take a look at what some major companies are doing thanks to these investments: ☀️ **First Solar** is expanding solar panel factories in Ohio and the Southeast U.S. 🏗️ **Corning** is building a new fiber optic cable factory in Arizona 🔋 **Honda** and **LG Energy Solution** announced they would build a new battery plant for electric vehicles in the U.S. 💲 **Toyota** and **Micron** announced new investments in American manufacturing This is all a direct result of President Biden’s _Made-In-America_ plan and Democrats’ hard work advancing our economy.

clean_body: Read on to learn more about what President Biden and Democrats nationwide have been up to this week → | | Derek -- we’re 60 days out from November’s midterm elections, and we need all hands on deck to protect our democracy. Last week in Philadelphia, President Biden made the case for electing Democrats: “America must choose: to move forward or to move backwards? To build the future or obsess about the past? To be a nation of hope and unity and optimism, or a nation of fear, division, and of darkness?” \-- President Joseph R. Biden, Jr. The choice is clear, Derek: We must do everything we can to defeat MAGA Republicans and elect Democrats to continue achieving the Biden-Harris agenda. Read on to learn more about what President Biden and Democrats nationwide have been up to this week → President Biden’s Labor Day Remarks On Monday, President Biden spoke of the fight unions and workers across the country have endured to keep our economy moving and make our nation strong. President Biden reiterated his promise to be the most pro-union president in American history. Thanks to his and Vice President Harris's leadership, we're going to build a future in America, with American workers, in American factories, using American-made products. American Manufacturing Grows Under President Biden Thanks to President Biden and historic legislation such as the Bipartisan Infrastructure Law, the Inflation Reduction Act , and the CHIPS and Science Act , American manufacturing is growing. Take a look at what some major companies are doing thanks to these investments: ☀️ First Solar is expanding solar panel factories in Ohio and the Southeast U.S. 🏗️ Corning is building a new fiber optic cable factory in Arizona 🔋 Honda and LG Energy Solution announced they would build a new battery plant for electric vehicles in the U.S. 💲 Toyota and Micron announced new investments in American manufacturing This is all a direct result of President Biden’s Made-In-America plan and Democrats’ hard work advancing our economy. [POSTERS] Soul of the Nation Derek -- have you seen these yet? These union-printed posters are a perfect addition to any office or home and a great way to show off your Democratic pride. Show your support for President Biden, Vice President Harris, and the Democratic Party by getting one (or all three!) of these posters today! [PHONE BANK] Take Action with the Democratic Party Midterm elections are right around the corner, and this grassroots team has the power to make all the difference. One of the best ways to engage folks is to talk with them on the phone. Whether you’re sharing information about an event or helping someone find their polling place, these conversations will be critical to electing Democrats up and down the ballot nationwide. So, what do you say, Derek? Will you sign up for phone bank training, make calls, and help elect Democrats nationwide? Less Than 60 Days → Derek -- we’re less than 60 days from the midterms, and there’s never been a more important time to protect our democracy.
